    I     you    he    she   it
    we    you    they

  TUShUM (fe'l/predlogdan KEYIN):

    us    you    them

  He loves her. (tushum - 'uni')

  BIR XIL.


⚠ O'ZBEKChA BILAN SOLIShTIRISh:

  biz → we / us

topics.topic: Grammar: Present Simple - Present Continuous — Grammatika: Present Simple - Present Continuous
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI HOZIRGI ZAMON.


=== PRESENT SIMPLE ===

ShAKLI:
  I / you / we / they  + FE'L
  he / she / it        + FE'L + S

  I work.      He workS.
  We live.     She liveS.

INKOR:
  I don't work.   He doesn't work.
  ⚠ 'doesn't' dan keyin -S TUShADI!
  'He doesn't workS' - XATO.

SO'ROQ:
  Do you work?   Does he work?

⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S QOIDALARI:
  work  → works
  go    → goes   (o, s, sh, ch, x dan
  watch → watches   keyin -ES)
  study → studies (undosh + y → -IES)
  play  → plays   (unli + y → faqat -S)
  have  → has     (istisno)

QAChON IShLATILADI:
  a) odat, kundalik ish
     'We spend our days hiking.'
  b) doimiy holat
     'Norwegians love the outdoors.'
  c) umumiy haqiqat
     'The sun rises in the east.'

BELGI SO'ZLARI:
  always, usually, often, sometimes,
  never, every day, on Mondays


=== PRESENT CONTINUOUS ===

ShAKLI:
  am / is / are + FE'L + ING

  I am working.
  He is working.
  We are working.

INKOR:
  I'm not working.
  He isn't working.

SO'ROQ:
  Are you working?
  Is he working?

⚠ -ING QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:
  work  → working
  make  → making   (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  sit   → sitting  (qisqa unli + bitta
                    undosh → UNDOSh
                    IKKILANADI)
  lie   → lying    (-ie → -ying)

QAChON IShLATILADI:
  c) aynan hozir bo'layotgan ish
     'At the moment we are having a
      cup of hot chocolate.'
  e) shu davrda bo'layotgan ish
     'I'm having a fantastic time.'
  d) yaqin kelajakdagi ANIQ reja
     'Next week we're going to Oslo.'

BELGI SO'ZLARI:
  now, at the moment, right now,
  today, this week, look!, listen!


=== ENG MUHIM FARQ ===

  'I work in a bank.'
     = mening kasbim shu (DOIMIY)

  'I'm working in a bank.'
     = hozircha shu yerda ishlayapman
       (VAQTINChA)


=== HOLAT FE'LLARI (state verbs) ===

  Bu fe'llar CONTINUOUS shaklda
  IShLATILMAYDI:

  like, love, hate, want, need,
  know, understand, believe,
  remember, forget, mean,
  belong, own, cost, seem

  ⚠ 'I am loving' - XATO.
     'I love' - to'g'ri.

  ⚠ Betdagi 26-mashqda: 'Mr Harris
  NEEDS me' - 'is needing' EMAS.


⚠ 'HAVE' - IKKI XIL:

  EGALIK ma'nosida - continuous YO'Q:
     'I have a car.' ('I am having a
      car' - XATO)

  IBORALARDA - continuous BOR:
     'We are having a cup of hot
      chocolate.'
     'I'm having a fantastic time.'
     'We are having a meeting.'

  ⚠ Xatda ikkalasi ham uchraydi!
examples: Present Simple: I work. / He works.
Present Simple negative: I don't work. / He doesn't work.
Present Continuous: I am working. / He is working.
Present Simple is used for habits, routines and permanent states.
Present Continuous is used for actions happening now or around now.
Present Continuous is also used for fixed arrangements in the near future.
State verbs (like, love, know, need, want) are not used in the continuous.
'have' takes the continuous only in expressions: have a meeting, have a good time.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (10-mashq qoidasi) (1)

⚠ RIALTO KO'PRIGI:

  Suratdagi ko'prik - Venetsiyadagi
  Rialto (1591), Katta kanal ustida.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (13-mashq qoidasi) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
USUALLY (simple) vs TODAY
  (continuous).

  QOLIP:
  X usually + V-S ..., but today
  he/she IS + V-ING ... .


RASMLAR:

  1 Kim: nonushta → sport zalida
    gantel ko'taryapti
  2 Paul: soqol olyapti → mashina
    yuvyapti
  3 Karen: velosipedda → taksiga
    chiqyapti


⚠ 'TO HAVE A SHAVE':

  = soqol olmoq. 'have' + ot.
  ⚠ 'to shave' fe'li ham bor.


⚠ 'TO WORK OUT':

  = sport zalida mashq qilmoq.
  'at the gym' = sport zalida.


⚠ 'TO CYCLE':

  = velosipedda yurmoq.
  'cycle TO work' = ishga velosipedda.


⚠ 'TO TAKE A TAXI':

  = taksiga chiqmoq ('take' bilan).
  ⚠ 'take a bus/train/taxi'.


⚠ 3-ShAXS: has, cycles.
  'have' → 'has' (noqonuniy!).

topics.topic: Adverbs of Frequency — Chastota ravishlari
topics.rule_uz:
ChASTOTA RAVIShLARI - QANChALIK
  TEZ-TEZ?

  100% always      = har doim
       usually     = odatda
       often       = tez-tez
       sometimes   = ba'zan
       occasionally = vaqti-vaqti
                      bilan
       rarely      = kamdan-kam
    0% never       = hech qachon


O'RNI - 3 QOIDA:

  1) ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
     I NEVER work on Saturdays.
     She RARELY takes the train.
     He SOMETIMES goes to the
     cinema.

  2) YORDAMChI FE'LDAN KEYIN:
     Do you OFTEN watch TV?

  3) 'TO BE' DAN KEYIN:
     Tom is USUALLY late.


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:

  'I work never' ✗
  'Tom usually is late' ✗
  → ravish 'to be' dan KEYIN.


⚠ 'NEVER' - INKOR:

  'I never work' - 'don't' KERAK
  EMAS ('I don't never work' ✗).
examples: always — usually — often — sometimes — occasionally — rarely — never
I never work on Saturdays. She rarely takes the train. He sometimes goes to the cinema. (before the main verb)
Do you often watch TV in the evening? (after the auxiliary verb)
Tom is usually late for school. (after the verb to be)

topics.topic: Past Simple — Past Simple (o'tgan oddiy zamon) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
PAST SIMPLE - ShAKLI.

  TASDIQ - HAMMA ShAXSDA BIR XIL:
    I / you / he / she / it / we /
    they WORKED
    ⚠ 3-shaxsda -s YO'Q!

  TO'G'RI fe'llar: + -ed
    work → worked
  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: alohida shakl
    sing → sang, go → went, buy →
    bought (kitob oxiridagi jadval)

  SO'ROQ: DID + ega + fe'l ASOSIY
    shakli
    Did he PLAY football yesterday?
    Did he GO swimming last week?
    ⚠ 'Did he played' ✗ - 'did'
    bo'lsa fe'l o'zgarmaydi!

  INKOR: DIDN'T + fe'l asosiy
    shakli
    I didn't PLAY football.
    I didn't GO swimming.

  QISQA JAVOB:
    Did you get up early? - Yes, I
    DID. / No, I DIDN'T.


⚠ -ED FAQAT BIR JOYDA:

  Tasdiqda fe'lda (played);
  so'roq/inkorda 'did'da - fe'l
  asosiy shaklda.
examples: I worked — Did I work? — I didn't work (same for all persons)
I work - I worked (regular: -ed); I sing - I sang (irregular)
Did he play football yesterday? Did he go swimming last week?
I didn't play football yesterday. I didn't go swimming last week.
'Did you get up early?' 'Yes, I did.' 'Did he watch TV?' 'No, he didn't.'

topics.topic: Past Simple — Past Simple (o'tgan oddiy zamon) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
-ED IMLOSI - 3 QOIDA.

  1) -e BILAN TUGASA: + -d
     live → lived, love → loved

  2) UNDOSh + y: -y → -ied
     try → tried, study → studied
     ⚠ unli + y: play → played
     (o'zgarmaydi)

  3) UNDOSh + URG'ULI UNLI +
     UNDOSh: oxirgi undosh
     IKKILANADI
     stop → stoPPed, plan → plaNNed
     ⚠ visit → visited (urg'u
     birinchi bo'g'inda -
     ikkilanmaydi)
examples: verbs ending in -e: + -d — I live - I lived
consonant + y → -ied — I try - I tried
one stressed vowel between two consonants → double consonant + -ed — I stop - I stopped

topics.topic: Past Simple — Past Simple (o'tgan oddiy zamon) (3)
topics.rule_uz:
PAST SIMPLE QAChON:

  1) O'TMIShDA ANIQ VAQTDA bo'lgan /
     tugagan harakat:
     Lisa BOUGHT a house LAST
     YEAR. (Qachon? - o'tgan yili)

  2) O'TMIShDAGI TAKRORLANGAN
     harakat (endi yo'q):
     He usually PLAYED football in
     his free time. (endi
     o'ynamaydi)


VAQT SO'ZLARI (belgilar):

  yesterday - kecha
  last night / week / year / month
    - o'tgan ...
  a month / two years ago - ...
    oldin
  in 1964 - yilda

  Fleming discovered penicillin IN
  1928.


⚠ 'AGO' OXIRIDA:

  'two years ago' (ago two years
  ✗).
examples: Lisa bought a house last year. (When? Last year.) — definite time in the past
He usually played football in his free time. (but he doesn't play football anymore.) — repeated action in the past
yesterday, last night/week/year/month, two years ago, in 1964 — Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928.

topics.topic: Used to — Used to (ilgari ... edi)
topics.rule_uz:
USED TO - ILGARI ... EDI (ENDI
  YO'Q).

  ShAKL: used to + FE'L (asosiy)
  Hamma shaxsda BIR XIL:
    I / she / they USED TO drink

  Sarah USED TO drink a lot of
  coffee. (endi ichmaydi)

  SO'ROQ: Did + ega + USE to ...?
    Did Sarah USE to drink ...?
  INKOR: didn't + USE to
    Sarah DIDN'T USE to drink ...

  ⚠ Savol va inkorda 'USE' (-d
  SIZ)! 'didn't used to' ✗


PAST SIMPLE BILAN BIR XIL:

  He USED TO live in a flat.
  = He LIVED in a flat.
  (ma'no farqi yo'q)


⚠ 'USED TO' FAQAT O'TMISh:

  Hozirgi odat uchun 'use to' YO'Q
  - 'usually' ishlatiladi.
examples: Sarah used to drink a lot of coffee. (Sarah doesn't drink a lot of coffee anymore.)
Did Sarah use to drink a lot of coffee? — Sarah didn't use to drink a lot of coffee.
He used to live in a flat. ALSO: He lived in a flat. (no difference in meaning)

topics.topic: Agreeing - Disagreeing - So - Neither/Nor — Qo'shilish - qo'shilmaslik - So - Neither/Nor
topics.rule_uz:
QO'ShILISh VA QO'ShILMASLIK.

  1) TASDIQQA QO'ShILISh - 'men
     ham':
     SO + yordamchi fe'l + ega
     A: Jim lives in Warsaw.
     B: SO DO I.

  2) INKORGA QO'ShILISh - 'men
     ham (...masman)':
     NEITHER / NOR + yordamchi fe'l
     + ega
     A: Eve doesn't like going to
        the cinema.
     B: NEITHER DOES Ann. / NOR
        DOES Ann.

  3) QO'ShILMASLIK:
     ega + yordamchi fe'l
     A: I never walk to school.
     B: Oh really? I DO.
     A: I often go swimming.
     B: I DON'T.


⚠ YORDAMChI FE'L GAPGA QARAB:

  lives → do / does
  is → am / is / are
  can → can
  went → did
  A: I can swim. B: So can I.
  A: I went home. B: So did I.


⚠ SO'Z TARTIBI:

  'So do I' (So I do ✗) - fe'l
  egadan OLDIN.
examples: A: Jim lives in Warsaw. B: So do I. (agree with a positive sentence)
A: Eve doesn't like going to the cinema. B: Neither/Nor does Ann. (agree with a negative sentence)
A: I never walk to school. B: Oh really? I do. (disagree)
A: I often go swimming at weekends. B: I don't. (disagree)

topics.topic: Grammar: Past Simple - 'used to' — Grammatika: Past Simple - 'used to' (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  1) 'We use USED TO or the PAST SIMPLE
     to describe past habits and states
     which don't happen/exist any more.'

     I worked / used to work as a cleaner.
        (past habit)
     I didn't have / didn't use to have
     long hair.  (state)

  2) 'We use the PAST SIMPLE for an action
     which happened at a specific time
     in the past.'

     We WENT to the beach last Saturday.
     NOT: We used to go to the beach
          last Saturday.


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  ANIQ VAQT ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa
  ('last Saturday', 'in 1999',
  'yesterday') - FAQAT past simple.

  ⚠ 'used to' TAKRORLANGAN odat yoki
  UZOQ DAVOM ETGAN holat uchun.


'USED TO' NING ShAKLLARI:

  Tasdiq:  I used to work.
  Inkor:   I didn't USE to work.
           (⚠ 'used' emas, 'USE'!)
  So'roq:  Did you USE to work?
           (⚠ yana 'USE')

  ⚠ 'didn't used to' - keng tarqalgan
  XATO. 'did' allaqachon o'tgan
  zamonni ko'rsatgan.


⚠ 'USED TO' va 'BE USED TO' -
BUTUNLAY BOShQA:

  'I used to smoke.'
     = ilgari chekardim (endi yo'q)

  'I am used to smoking.'
     = chekishga o'rganib qolganman

  ⚠ Ikkinchisida 'be' bor va keyin
  -ING keladi!


PAST SIMPLE QANDAY YaSALADI:

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (regular): + -ED
     start → started
     enjoy → enjoyed
     live  → lived   ('e' bor, faqat -D)
     travel → travelled (Britaniyada
        'l' IKKILANADI)
     study → studied (undosh + y → -ied)

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (irregular):
     be    → was/were
     go    → went
     sing  → sang
     have  → had
     learn → learnt (yoki learned)

  ⚠ Noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati kitob
  oxirida (128-bet).


⚠ -ED NING TALAFFUZI - UCh XIL:

  /t/  - jarangsizdan keyin: worked,
         watched, finished
  /d/  - jaranglidan keyin: lived,
         enjoyed, travelled
  /id/ - 't' yoki 'd' dan keyin:
         started, needed, wanted

  ⚠ Bu 7-unitning talaffuz mavzusi.
examples: We use used to or the past simple to describe past habits and states which don't happen/exist any more.
I worked / used to work as a cleaner. (past habit)
I didn't have / didn't use to have long hair. (state)
We use the past simple for an action which happened at a specific time in the past.
We went to the beach last Saturday. NOT: We used to go to the beach last Saturday.

topics.topic: Grammar: Past Simple - 'used to' — Grammatika: Past Simple - 'used to' (18-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI GURUH - IKKI QOIDA.

  ⚠ Kitob ataylab ikki ramkaga
  bo'lgan:

  CHAP RAMKA (och pushti) - ichida
  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar ham bor:
     appear → appeared (to'g'ri)
     travel → travelled (to'g'ri)
     be     → was      (NOTO'G'RI)
     live   → lived    (to'g'ri)
     sing   → sang     (NOTO'G'RI)
     go     → went     (NOTO'G'RI)

  O'NG RAMKA (och yashil):
     learn   → learnt   (NOTO'G'RI/to'g'ri)
     receive → received (to'g'ri)
     start   → started  (to'g'ri)
     change  → changed  (to'g'ri)
     have    → had      (NOTO'G'RI)
     enjoy   → enjoyed  (to'g'ri)


⚠ -ED QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:

  1) Oddiy: start → startED,
     appear → appearED, enjoy → enjoyED

  2) 'E' bilan tugasa - faqat -D:
     live → liveD, receive → receiveD,
     change → changeD

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IED:
     study → studied, carry → carried

  4) UNLI + Y → oddiy -ED:
     enjoy → enjoyed, play → played

  5) Qisqa unli + bitta undosh →
     UNDOSh IKKILANADI:
     stop → stopped, plan → planned
     ⚠ Britaniyada 'travel' → 'travelLED'
     (AQShda 'traveled').


⚠ 'LEARNT' va 'LEARNED':

  Britaniyada 'learnt', AQShda
  'learned'. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: burnt/burned,
  dreamt/dreamed, spelt/spelled.


⚠ 'BE' - ENG NOTO'G'RI FE'L:

  I / he / she / it → WAS
  you / we / they   → WERE

  ⚠ Bu YAGONA fe'l bo'lib, o'tgan
  zamonda IKKI shaklga ega.

topics.topic: Grammar: Past Simple - 'used to' — Grammatika: Past Simple - 'used to' (19-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Did you read a newspaper last
      Monday?
  SB: No, I didn't. I went swimming.


KO'RSATMALAR:

  Chap ramka (ish):
     read a newspaper
     watch TV
     play tennis
     visit your grandparents
     go swimming
     ring a friend

  O'ng ramka (vaqt):
     last Monday?
     last night?
     last weekend?
     yesterday?
     a week ago?
     this morning?


⚠ PAST SIMPLE SO'ROQ:

  DID + ega + FE'L (ODDIY ShAKLDA)

  'DID you READ ...?'
  ⚠ 'Did you read?' - 'read' ODDIY
  shaklda ('did you readED' XATO).

  ⚠ Lekin TALAFFUZ farq qiladi:
  'read' hozirgi zamonda /riːd/,
  o'tganda /red/.


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  'Yes, I did.' / 'No, I didn't.'
  ⚠ Asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.


⚠ VAQT IFODALARI:

  last Monday   - o'tgan dushanba
  last night    - kecha kechqurun
  last weekend  - o'tgan dam olish kuni
  yesterday     - kecha
  a week ago    - bir hafta oldin
  this morning  - bugun ertalab

  ⚠ 'AGO' - HAR DOIM son bilan va
  gap OXIRIDA: 'two days ago'.
  ⚠ 'before' bilan ADAShTIRMANG.

  ⚠ 'last' oldidan predlog QO'YILMAYDI:
  'ON last Monday' - XATO.


⚠ 'THIS MORNING' - IKKI ZAMON:

  Agar hozir ertalab bo'lsa:
     'Have you read ...?' (present perfect)
  Agar hozir kechqurun bo'lsa:
     'Did you read ...?' (past simple)

  ⚠ Bu 7-unitning mavzusi.


⚠ 'TO RING' = TELEFON QILMOQ:

  ring - rang - rung (NOTO'G'RI fe'l)
  ⚠ 'sing - sang - sung' bilan bir xil
  qolip (18-mashqda 'sing' bor edi).
  ⚠ 'to phone', 'to call' ham bir xil
  ma'noda.

topics.topic: Grammar: Past Simple - 'used to' — Grammatika: Past Simple - 'used to' (2)
topics.rule_uz:
'THEN' VA 'NOW' - O'ZGARISh.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Pauline used to have short orange
   hair, but now she's got long brown
   hair.'

  ⚠ Qolip: used to + FE'L, but now +
     PRESENT.


THEN (rasmdagi yorliqlar):
  short orange hair - kalta to'q sariq soch
  glasses - ko'zoynak
  brightly coloured T-shirts - yorqin
     rangli futbolkalar
  ripped jeans - yirtiq jinsi

NOW (qaydlar):
  * ⚠ hair: long, ... (rangi audiodan)
  eyes: contact lenses
  * ⚠ clothes: smart ... (qanaqa - audiodan)
  habits: not smoke any more


⚠ 'USED TO BE LIKE':

  'what Pauline used to BE LIKE'
  = Polina qanday ODAM/QANDAY
    KO'RINIShDA bo'lgan.

  ⚠ 'be like' - 6-betdagi 2-mashqda
  o'rganilgan edi.


⚠ 'GLASSES' va 'CONTACT LENSES':

  glasses - ko'zoynak (HAR DOIM KO'PLIK)
  contact lenses - kontakt linzalar
     ⚠ 'a lens' → 'lenses'


⚠ 'RIPPED JEANS':

  'to rip' = yirtmoq
  → 'ripped' = yirtilgan
  ⚠ 'jeans' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA
  (trousers, shorts kabi).


⚠ 'SMART':

  Britaniyada 'smart' = OZODA, chiroyli
  kiyingan.
  ⚠ AQShda 'smart' = AQLLI.
  ⚠ Britaniyada aqlli - 'clever'.


⚠ 'NOT ... ANY MORE':

  'She doesn't smoke ANY MORE.'
  = U endi chekmaydi.

  ⚠ 'any more' (ikki so'z) - Britaniya;
  'anymore' (bir so'z) - AQSh.


⚠ GAP TUZISh QOLIPI:

  'She used to ... , but now she ... '
  yoki
  'She didn't use to ... , but now
   she ... '
examples: THEN: short orange hair. NOW: long, ... hair.
THEN: glasses. NOW: contact lenses.
THEN: brightly coloured T-shirts and ripped jeans. NOW: smart ... clothes.
NOW habits: she does not smoke any more.
Pauline used to have short orange hair, but now she's got long brown hair.

topics.topic: Grammar exercise — Grammatika mashqi (24-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
JON VA TONINING TANIShUVI.

  Toni - italiyalik, Glazgo
  universitetida tibbiyot o'qiydi.


⚠ ZAMONNI QANDAY TANLASh:

  PRESENT SIMPLE - doimiy holat, odat:
     'Where DO you COME from?'
     'I COME from Italy.'
     'Where DO you STUDY?'
     'DO you GO to lectures every day?'
     'They START at 9:30.'
     'How DO you TRAVEL ...?'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS - vaqtinchalik
  holat va yaqin reja:
     'What ARE you STUDYING?'
        (hozirgi o'quv kursi)
     'What ARE you DOING this evening?'
        (bugungi reja)
     "I'M STUDYING for a test."
     "I'M MEETING some friends."
     "We'RE GOING to a new club."


⚠ 3 va 5-BANDLARNING FARQI:

  3: 'What ARE you STUDYING?'
     = hozir qaysi fanni o'qiyapsiz?
     (vaqtinchalik - kurs tugaydi)

  5: 'Where DO you STUDY?'
     = qayerda o'qiysiz?
     (doimiy - universitet o'zgarmaydi)

  ⚠ Bir xil fe'l, ikki xil zamon -
  butun mashqning maqsadi shu.


⚠ 11, 12, 13-BANDLAR - BUGUNGI REJA:

  'I'm studying for a test, then I'm
   meeting some friends. We're going to
   a new club in town.'

  ⚠ Uchalasi ham PRESENT CONTINUOUS,
  chunki bular ANIQ, kelishilgan
  rejalar (10-betdagi 'd' qo'llanishi).


⚠ 'WHERE DO YOU COME FROM?':

  = qayerliksiz?
  ⚠ 'Where are you from?' bilan bir xil
  ma'no.
  ⚠ 'from' HAR DOIM oxirida qoladi.


⚠ 'MEDICINE':

  = tibbiyot (fan); dori.
  ⚠ Fan nomi sifatida ARTIKLSIZ:
  'I study Medicine.'


⚠ 'A LECTURE':

  = ma'ruza (universitetda).
  ⚠ 'a lesson' - maktabda,
  'a lecture' - universitetda.


⚠ 'BY BUS' - ARTIKLSIZ:

  'How do you travel? - By bus.'
  ⚠ 14-betdagi 15-mashqda ham shu qolip.

topics.topic: Grammar: Present Simple — Grammatika: Present Simple
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  'We use the present simple to talk
   about daily routines and habits.'
  e.g. He goes to work by bus.

  ⚠ 'e.g.' = 'exempli gratia' (lotincha)
  = masalan.


⚠ 'BY BUS' - TRANSPORT USULI:

  by bus, by car, by train, by plane,
  by bike, by taxi

  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ! 'by a bus' - XATO.
  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' = piyoda
  ('by foot' XATO).


3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S QOIDALARI
(10-mashqning butun mavzusi):

  1) Ko'pchilik fe'lga oddiy -S:
     play → plays, read → reads,
     make → makes, leave → leaves

  2) -O, -S, -SH, -CH, -X bilan
     tugasa → -ES:
     go → goes, do → does,
     watch → watches, finish → finishes,
     brush → brushes, fix → fixes

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IES:
     study → studies, fly → flies

  4) UNLI + Y → faqat -S:
     play → plays, buy → buys

  5) ISTISNO: have → HAS


⚠ -S NING TALAFFUZI - UCh XIL:

  /s/  - jarangsiz tovushdan keyin:
     makes, sleeps, works
  /z/  - jarangli tovushdan keyin:
     plays, reads, goes
  /iz/ - shivirlovchi tovushdan keyin:
     watches, finishes, brushes

  ⚠ Bu qoida ko'plik -S ga ham,
  o'tgan zamon -ED ga ham o'xshash.
examples: We use the present simple to talk about daily routines and habits.
e.g. He goes to work by bus.

topics.topic: Grammar: Present Simple — Grammatika: Present Simple (10-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK (he/she/it).

  ⚠ Bu - ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p
  unutiladigan qoida. O'zbekchada
  fe'l shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi,
  shuning uchun -S doim esdan chiqadi.


QOIDALAR VA BANDLAR:

  ODDIY -S:
     play → plays (3)
     read → reads (4)
     make → makes (7)
     leave → leaves (8)

  -O, -S, -SH, -CH, -X → -ES:
     go → goes (1)
     watch → watches (2)
     finish → finishes (6)
     do → does (9)
     brush → brushes (10)

  ISTISNO:
     have → has (5)


⚠ 'DOES' TALAFFUZI:

  'do' /duː/ → 'does' /dʌz/
  ⚠ Unli TOVUSh o'zgaradi!

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday 'say' /seɪ/ →
  'says' /sez/.


⚠ INKOR VA SO'ROQDA -S TUShADI:

  He goes. → He doesn't GO.
  He goes? → Does he GO?

  ⚠ 'He doesn't goes' - XATO.
  ⚠ -S allaqachon 'does' ichida.

topics.topic: Grammar: Present Simple — Grammatika: Present Simple (11b-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
JADVALDAN GAP TUZISH.

  ⚠ Har qatordan bitta gap chiqadi.

  ⚠ Qolip: He + FE'L + S + at + SOAT.

  ⚠ 3-shaxs birlik -S ni UNUTMANG:
     wakeS, haS, leaveS, startS,
     finishES, getS, goES.


⚠ IKKI ISh BITTA GAPDA:

  'He leaves the house at 6:45 am AND
   catches the bus.'

  ⚠ Ikkinchi fe'lga ham -S qo'shiladi!
  'and catch the bus' - XATO.

topics.topic: Grammar: Adverbs of Frequency — Grammatika: Takrorlanish ravishlari (12-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI - 0% dan
100% gacha.

  1  never        0%
  2  rarely       ~10%
  3  occasionally ~25%
  4  sometimes    ~40%
  5  often        ~60%
  6  usually      ~85%
  7  always       100%

  ⚠ Kitobda 1 (never) va 7 (always)
  BERILGAN - qolgan beshtasini
  ro'yxatdan joylashtirasiz.


⚠ GAPDA QAYERGA QO'YILADI - UCh QOIDA:

  1) ODDIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
     'I ALWAYS get up early.'
     'He OFTEN plays football.'

  2) 'TO BE' DAN KEYIN:
     'She is ALWAYS late.'
     'They are USUALLY at home.'
     ⚠ 'She always is late' - XATO!

  3) YORDAMChI FE'L BILAN - o'rtada:
     'I have NEVER been to London.'
     'He can USUALLY come.'

  ⚠ Qisqa qoida: ravish ASOSIY fe'ldan
  oldin, lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN.


⚠ ISTISNO - GAP BOShIDA VA OXIRIDA:

  'sometimes', 'usually', 'often',
  'occasionally' gap boshida ham
  turishi mumkin:
     'Sometimes I go to the cinema.'

  ⚠ Lekin 'always' va 'never' gap
  boshida TURMAYDI (buyruq gapdan
  tashqari: 'Never do that!').


⚠ 'RARELY', 'SELDOM', 'HARDLY EVER':

  Uchalasi ham 'kamdan-kam' degani.
  ⚠ Ular INKOR ma'noli, shuning uchun
  gapda yana 'not' QO'ShILMAYDI:
  'I rarely don't go' - XATO.


⚠ 'HOW OFTEN ...?' - SAVOL:

  'How often do you play tennis?'
     - 'Twice a week.'
     - 'I usually play at weekends.'

topics.topic: Grammar exercise — Grammatika mashqi (26-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
RASMDAGI TO'RTTA XATO.

  Qadimgi Misrda BO'LMAGAN narsalar:

  1) MOTOTSIKL
  2) KOSTYUM-ShIM (suit)
  3) WALKMAN (quloqchinli pleyer)
  4) MOBIL TELEFON

  ⚠ Sandal va bilakuzuk esa qadimgi
  Misrda HAQIQATAN bo'lgan - shuning
  uchun 1 va 5-bandlar TASDIQ gap
  bo'ladi.


⚠ QOLIP:

  TASDIQ: They USED TO wear sandals.
  INKOR:  They DIDN'T USE TO ride
          motorbikes.

  ⚠ INKORDA 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
  ⚠ "didn't used to" - eng keng
  tarqalgan xato.


⚠ QAYSI BAND TASDIQ, QAYSI INKOR:

  1  sandals        → TASDIQ (bo'lgan)
  2  motorbikes     → INKOR (xato)
  3  Walkmans       → INKOR (xato)
  4  men/suits      → INKOR (xato)
  5  women/bracelets → TASDIQ (bo'lgan)
  6  mobile phones  → INKOR (xato)

  ⚠ To'rtta INKOR - aynan rasmdagi
  to'rtta xato.


⚠ 'TO SPOT':

  = payqamoq, ko'zi tushmoq.
  ⚠ 'a spot' (ot) = dog'; joy.
  ⚠ 'spot the difference' - bolalar
  o'yini: farqni top.


⚠ 'ANCIENT':

  = qadimiy. /ˈeɪnʃənt/ deb o'qiladi.
  ⚠ 7-betdagi Tailand matnida ham
  bor edi: 'ancient temples'.


⚠ 'A WALKMAN':

  = ko'chma kassetali pleyer (Sony
  firmasining nomi).
  ⚠ Kitob 2000-yilda yozilgan - o'sha
  paytda bu eng zamonaviy qurilma edi.


⚠ 'A BRACELET':

  = bilakuzuk. Fransuzchadan kirgan.
  ⚠ Qadimgi Misrda erkaklar ham,
  ayollar ham taqqan.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (9-mashq qoidasi) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
USED TO - O'TGAN ODAT
  (coursebook 15-bet qoidasi).

  QOLIP:
  THEN: Sam USED TO + fe'l ... when
        he was younger.
  NOW:  Now he + fe'l-S ... .


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Sam used to wear designer
   clothes when he was younger.
   Now he wears old clothes.'


⚠ 'USED TO' = ILGARI ... EDI
  (HOZIR YO'Q):

  'He used to drive a sports car' =
  ilgari sport mashina haydardi
  (hozir haydamaydi).

  ⚠ 'used to' dan keyin FE'L
  ODDIY ShAKLDA.
  ⚠ Hamma shaxs uchun bir xil:
  I/he/they used to.


⚠ 'NOW' - PRESENT SIMPLE:

  'Now he wears/rides/is/lives/
  cooks/doesn't have/wakes up'.


⚠ 'BE MARRIED TO':

  = ... ga uylangan/turmushga
  chiqqan ('with' EMAS!).
  'be divorced' = ajrashgan.


⚠ 'A TERRACED HOUSE':

  = qatorli uy (Britaniyada bir-
  biriga tutash uylar qatori).


⚠ 'HIS OWN FOOD':

  'own' = o'zining. 'cook his own
  food' = o'z ovqatini o'zi
  pishiradi.


⚠ 'DESIGNER CLOTHES':

  = mashhur dizayner kiyimlari
  (qimmat).

topics.topic: Adjectives — Sifatlar
topics.rule_uz:
SIFAT - OTNI TASVIRLAYDI.

  1) BIRLIK VA KO'PLIKDA BIR XIL:
     a RED car - two RED cars
     ⚠ 'reds cars' ✗ - sifatga -s
     qo'shilmaydi!

  2) OTDAN OLDIN:
     a LARGE box (box large ✗)

  3) 'TO BE' VA HIS FE'LLARIDAN
     KEYIN YOLG'IZ:
     Mary IS tall.
     You LOOK sad.
     It SMELLS horrible.
     (look, smell, sound, feel,
     taste)


IKKI XIL SIFAT:

  FIKR (opinion) - odam nima deb
    o'ylaydi: beautiful, lovely,
    great, expensive
  FAKT (fact) - haqiqiy ma'lumot:
    short (o'lcham), square (shakl),
    yellow (rang), cotton (material)


⚠ O'ZBEKChA BILAN O'XShASh:

  'qizil mashina' - sifat otdan
  oldin, ko'plikda o'zgarmaydi -
  inglizcha ham shunday.
examples: a red car - (two) red cars (same form in singular and plural)
a large box (adjectives go before nouns)
Mary is tall. You look sad. It smells horrible. (after to be, look, smell, sound, feel, taste)
opinion adjectives: beautiful, lovely, great, expensive — fact adjectives: short, square, yellow, cotton

topics.topic: Order of Adjectives — Sifatlar tartibi
topics.rule_uz:
SIFATLAR TARTIBI.

  FIKR → FAKT:
    a BEAUTIFUL (fikr) SILK (fakt)
    scarf

  FAKT SIFATLARI TARTIBI:
    1 O'LChAM   small, big, short,
                long
    2 OG'IRLIK  heavy, light
    3 ShAKL     triangular, round,
                rectangular, square
    4 RANG      dark/light blue,
                yellow, pink, cream,
                red, purple
    5 MATERIAL  cotton, leather,
                silk, plastic,
                woollen, nylon,
                metal, gold, silver,
                velvet, wooden,
                canvas, china

  an EXPENSIVE (fikr), RED (rang),
  LEATHER (material) suitcase

  ⚠ Odatda 2-3 sifatdan ko'p
  ishlatilmaydi.


⚠ 'CHINA':

  = chinni (material); China =
  Xitoy.


⚠ 'LIGHT':

  = yengil (og'irlik) YOKI och
  (rang): light blue = och ko'k.
examples: a beautiful silk scarf (opinion before fact)
size → weight → shape → colour → material
an expensive, red, leather suitcase

topics.topic: Comparisons — Qiyoslash darajalari
topics.rule_uz:
QIYOSLASh - 3 DARAJA.

  ODDIY → QIYOSIY (-roq) →
  ORTTIRMA (eng)

  1) BIR BO'G'INLI: -er / the -est
     cheap → cheapER → the
       cheapEST
     large → largER → the largEST
       (-e bor - faqat -r/-st)
     big → biGGer → the biGGest
       (undosh ikkilanadi)

  2) -Y BILAN TUGAYDIGAN: -y → -ier
     / the -iest
     easy → easIER → the easIEST

  3) IKKI+ BO'G'INLI: more / the
     most
     intelligent → MORE intelligent
       → THE MOST intelligent

  4) NOTO'G'RI (yodlash):
     good → better → the best
     bad → worse → the worst
     much/many → more → the most
     little → less → the least
     far → further/farther → the
       furthest/farthest


⚠ ORTTIRMADA 'THE' ShART:

  'the cheapest' (cheapest ✗).


⚠ 'MORE CHEAPER' ✗:

  Yo -er, yo more - ikkalasi emas.
examples: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; large - larger - the largest; big - bigger - the biggest (one syllable)
easy - easier - the easiest (-y adjectives)
intelligent - more intelligent - the most intelligent (two or more syllables)
good - better - the best; bad - worse - the worst; much/many - more - the most; little - less - the least; far - further/farther - the furthest/farthest

topics.topic: Comparisons - Form and Use — Qiyoslash - shakli va ishlatilishi (1)
topics.rule_uz:
QIYOSLASh ShAKLI - IMLO.

  1) BIR BO'G'INLI: + -er / -est
     cheap → cheaper → the cheapest
     large → largER → the largEST
     (-e bor: faqat -r / -st)

  2) UNDOSh + UNLI + UNDOSh:
     ikkilanadi
     big → biGGer → the biGGest
     hot → hoTTer → the hoTTest

  3) UNDOSh + -y: -y → -ier / -iest
     heavy → heavIER → the heavIEST
     easy → easier → the easiest

  4) IKKI+ BO'G'INLI: more / the
     most
     careful → MORE careful → THE
     MOST careful

  5) NOTO'G'RI: good/better/best
     ...


ESLATMA:

  Qiyosiy + THAN: bigger THAN
  Orttirma + THE: THE biggest
  Orttirma + OF / IN: the biggest
  IN the world / OF all
examples: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in); cheap - cheaper - the cheapest
big - bigger - the biggest (double the last consonant)
heavy - heavier - the heaviest (-y → -ier/-iest)
careful - more careful - the most careful (two or more syllables)
than (comparative) — the (superlative)

topics.topic: Comparisons - Form and Use — Qiyoslash - shakli va ishlatilishi (2)
topics.rule_uz:
QIYOSLASh - 5 XIL QOLIP.

  1) QIYOSIY + THAN (ikki narsa):
     Sue's skirt is LONGER THAN
     Mary's.

  2) THE + ORTTIRMA + OF/IN (butun
     guruh):
     Pluto is THE COLDEST planet IN
     our solar system.

  3) (NOT) AS + SIFAT + AS (bir
     xil / bir xil emas):
     Tom is AS TALL AS Peter.
     Peter is NOT AS TALL AS Sally.

  4) LESS + SIFAT + THAN (kamroq):
     The green jacket is LESS
     EXPENSIVE THAN the yellow one.

  5) MUCH + QIYOSIY + THAN (ancha):
     This tie is MUCH LONGER THAN
     that one.


⚠ 'MARY'S' = Mary's skirt:

  Takrorlamaslik uchun egalik
  shakli yolg'iz qoladi.
examples: Sue's skirt is longer than Mary's. (comparative + than: two things)
Pluto is the coldest planet in our solar system. (superlative: whole group)
Tom is as tall as Peter. ((not) as ... as: similar / not similar)
The green jacket is less expensive than the yellow jacket. (less + adjective + than)
This tie is much longer than that one. (much + comparative + than)

topics.topic: Expressing Certainty: Must - Can't — Ishonch ifodasi: Must - Can't
topics.rule_uz:
IShONChLI TAXMIN - MUST / CAN'T.

  MUST + fe'l = bo'lsa kerak
    (mantiqan TO'G'RI - dalil bor)
    They look the same. They MUST
    BE twins.

  CAN'T + fe'l = bo'lishi mumkin
    emas (mantiqan NOTO'G'RI)
    This book CAN'T BE his. He
    doesn't like detective stories.

  ⚠ Bu yerda 'must' - majburiyat
  EMAS, taxmin. 'can't' -
  qobiliyat EMAS, taxmin.

  ⚠ Inkori 'mustn't' EMAS - 'can't'!
  (mustn't = taqiq)
examples: They look the same. They must be twins. (logically true)
This book can't be his. He doesn't like detective stories. (logically untrue)

topics.topic: Will (predictions) — Will (bashorat)
topics.rule_uz:
WILL - BAShORAT (fikrga
  asoslangan).

  I THINK he WILL help me.
  I EXPECT it will rain.
  He will PROBABLY come.

  Belgi so'zlar: think, expect,
  probably, I'm sure, perhaps.

  ⚠ will + fe'l ASOSIY shakli
  (will to help ✗, will helps ✗).
  ⚠ Qisqa: I'll, he'll; inkor:
  won't.
examples: I think he will help me. (prediction based on what we think)

topics.topic: Comparisons — Qiyoslash (1-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
QOLIPGA QARAB ShAKL TANLASh.

  ... than → qiyosiy
  the ... in/ever → orttirma
  as ... as / less ... than / very
    ... → ODDIY shakl (o'zgarmaydi!)
  much ... than → qiyosiy

  1 bigger (NAMUNA)
  2 as TALL as (oddiy)
  3 MORE POLLUTED than (uzun)
  4 the WORST (noto'g'ri; 'I've
    ever eaten')
  5 less MODERN than (oddiy)
  6 very FAMOUS (oddiy)
  7 as RICH as (oddiy)
  8 the MOST BEAUTIFUL (uzun)
  9 MORE COMFORTABLE than
  10 MORE EXPENSIVE than
  11 much CHEAPER than
  12 the LARGEST (-e bor)


⚠ 'POLLUTED':

  = ifloslangan.


⚠ 'THE DANUBE':

  = Dunay daryosi.

topics.topic: Grammar: Order of Adjectives — Grammatika: Sifatlar tartibi (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI.


1) SIFAT OTNI TASVIRLAYDI:

  'Adjectives describe nouns. They have
   the same form in the singular and
   plural.'

  e.g. a blue dress - two blue dresses

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM FARQ: ingliz sifati
  KO'PLIKDA O'ZGARMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'two blueS dresses' - XATO.


2) IKKI TUR SIFAT:

  OPINION (fikr) adjectives:
     beautiful, great, expensive, nice
     = biz NIMA DEB O'YLAYMIZ

  FACT (haqiqat) adjectives:
     short, long, red, wooden
     = narsa ASLIDA QANDAY

  ⚠ QOIDA: OPINION sifati FACT
  sifatidan OLDIN turadi.

  'She's wearing a BEAUTIFUL RED dress.'
     (opinion) (fact)

  ⚠ 'a red beautiful dress' - XATO.


3) FACT SIFATLARINING TARTIBI:

  size     - small, big, short, long
  weight   - heavy, light
  shape    - triangular, round,
             rectangular, square
  colour   - dark/light blue, yellow,
             pink, cream, red, purple
  material - cotton, leather, silk,
             plastic, woollen, nylon,
             metal, gold, silver, velvet,
             wooden, canvas

  ⚠ KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "It's a beautiful, long, light blue,
   silk skirt."
     beautiful - OPINION
     long      - SIZE
     light blue - COLOUR
     silk      - MATERIAL


⚠ QISQA ESLATMA (yodlash uchun):

  FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK →
  ShAKL → RANG → MATERIAL → OT

  ⚠ O'zbekchada bunday qat'iy tartib
  yo'q - shuning uchun bu qoidani
  ataylab yodlash kerak.


⚠ VERGUL QO'YILADIMI:

  Kitobdagi namunada vergul bor:
  'a beautiful, long, light blue, silk
   skirt'
  ⚠ Vergulsiz ham to'g'ri:
  'a beautiful long light blue silk
   skirt'
  ⚠ Amalda 2-3 tadan ortiq sifat kam
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ MATERIAL SIFATLARI - OTDAN:

  gold, silver, metal, plastic, silk,
  cotton, velvet, canvas - bular OT,
  lekin sifat vazifasida ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ Ba'zilari -EN oladi:
     wood → wooden
     wool → woollen
     gold → golden (ko'chma ma'noda)

  ⚠ 'a gold ring' = oltindan uzuk
  ⚠ 'a golden opportunity' = oltin
     imkoniyat (ko'chma)
examples: Adjectives describe nouns. They have the same form in the singular and plural. e.g. a blue dress - two blue dresses
Opinion adjectives (beautiful, great, expensive) describe what we think of someone or something.
Fact adjectives (short, long, red) describe what someone or something really is.
Opinion adjectives go before fact adjectives. She's wearing a beautiful red dress.
size: small, big, short, long, etc
weight: heavy, light, etc
shape: triangular, round, rectangular, square, etc
colour: dark/light blue, yellow, pink, cream, red, purple, etc

topics.topic: Grammar: Order of Adjectives — Grammatika: Sifatlar tartibi (2)
topics.rule_uz:
19-BETDAGI MAQOLADAN.


FACT ADJECTIVES (haqiqat) - misollar:

  large (department stores) - o'lcham
  small (antique shops)    - o'lcham
  little (streets)         - o'lcham
  woollen (skirts)         - material
  leather (jackets)        - material
  big (bank accounts)      - o'lcham

  ⚠ Bularni O'LChASh yoki KO'RISh
  mumkin.


OPINION ADJECTIVES (fikr) - misollar:

  delightful (smaller shops)
  fantastic (furniture)
  great (department stores / variety)
  rare (books)
  trendiest (boutiques)
  fashionable (clothes)

  ⚠ Bular bir odamga to'g'ri, boshqasiga
  noto'g'ri tuyulishi mumkin.


⚠ 'HIGH QUALITY' - QAYSI TUR:

  'high quality woollen skirts'
  ⚠ 'high quality' bu yerda OT+OT
  birikmasi bo'lib, sifat vazifasida.
  Uni ham FIKR sifatiga yaqin deb
  hisoblash mumkin.


⚠ 'RARE' - CHEGARADAGI SO'Z:

  'a rare book' - kitobning kam
  uchrashi HAQIQAT, lekin 'noyob'
  deyish BAHO ham beradi.

  ⚠ Bunday chegaradagi so'zlar bor -
  muhimi, tartibni to'g'ri qo'yish.
examples: FACT: large department stores
FACT: small antique shops
FACT: woollen skirts, leather jackets
OPINION: delightful smaller shops
OPINION: fantastic furniture
OPINION: the trendiest boutiques, fashionable clothes

topics.topic: Grammar: Order of Adjectives — Grammatika: Sifatlar tartibi (12-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
TARTIB: FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK →
ShAKL → RANG → MATERIAL


HAR BANDNING TAHLILI:

  1  brown (rang) = 2
     wooden (material) = 3
     beautiful (fikr) = 1
     → 'a BEAUTIFUL BROWN WOODEN box
        with a brass lock'
     ⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN (namuna).

  2  cotton (material) = 3
     large (o'lcham) = 1
     grey (rang) = 2
     → 'a LARGE GREY COTTON shirt with
        a white collar'

  3  heavy (og'irlik) = 1
     metal (material) = 3
     black (rang) = 2
     → 'a HEAVY BLACK METAL saucepan
        with brown handles'

  4  silk (material) = 3
     blue (rang) = 2
     nice (fikr) = 1
     → 'a NICE BLUE SILK scarf with
        yellow stars on it'


⚠ HAR BANDDA MATERIAL OXIRIDA:

  wooden, cotton, metal, silk -
  hammasi OTGA ENG YaQIN turadi.

  ⚠ Bu - eng oson eslab qolinadigan
  qoida: MATERIAL HAR DOIM OXIRIDA.


⚠ 'WITH' BILAN QO'ShIMChA TAFSILOT:

  '... with a brass lock'
  '... with a white collar'
  '... with brown handles'
  '... with yellow stars on it'

  ⚠ Sifatlar OTDAN OLDIN, qo'shimcha
  tafsilot esa 'with' bilan OTDAN
  KEYIN.


⚠ YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  brass    = jez, latun
  a lock   = qulf
  a collar = yoqa
  a saucepan = kastryulka
  a handle = dasta
  a scarf  = ro'mol, sharf

topics.topic: Grammar: Order of Adjectives — Grammatika: Sifatlar tartibi (13-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  "It's a grey plastic suitcase with
   stickers on it."

  ⚠ Qolip: It's a + SIFATLAR + OT +
     with + QO'ShIMChA TAFSILOT.


SURATDAGI BUYUMLAR VA QISMLARI:

  a suitcase - stickers (yorliqlar)
  a ring - diamonds (olmoslar)
  an umbrella - a handle (dasta)
  a travel bag - a strap (tasma),
     a zip (zamok), a side pocket
     (yon cho'ntak)
  a ball - spots (dog'lar)
  shoes - laces (bog'ichlar)
  a cap - a peak (kozirok)
  a pen - a top (qopqoq)


⚠ 'WITH ... ON IT':

  'with stickers ON IT' = ustida
  yorliqlari bor.

  ⚠ 'on it' - buyum ustidagi narsa
  uchun. Ichidagi narsa uchun 'in it'.


⚠ 'A ZIP' va 'A ZIPPER':

  Britaniyada 'a zip', AQShda
  'a zipper'.


⚠ 'SHOES' - HAR DOIM JUFTLIKDA:

  'a pair of shoes' = bir juft tufli.
  ⚠ 'laces' ham ko'plikda.


⚠ 'A PEAK':

  = kepkaning kozirogi; cho'qqi.
  ⚠ 'peak' va 'pick' talaffuzi boshqa:
  peak /piːk/ (uzun), pick /pɪk/ (qisqa).

topics.topic: Grammar: Making Comparisons — Grammatika: Qiyoslash
topics.rule_uz:
SIFATNING UCh DARAJASI.

  1) ODDIY (positive):    big
  2) QIYoSIY (comparative): biggER THAN
  3) ENG YUQORI (superlative):
     THE biggEST


QANDAY YaSALADI - UZUNLIGIGA QARAB:

  QISQA SIFATLAR (bir bo'g'inli va
  ba'zi ikki bo'g'inli):
     + -ER / THE + -EST

     short  → shorter  → the shortest
     long   → longer   → the longest
     cheap  → cheaper  → the cheapest

  UZUN SIFATLAR (ikki va undan ko'p
  bo'g'inli):
     MORE + sifat / THE MOST + sifat

     expensive → more expensive →
        the most expensive
     beautiful → more beautiful →
        the most beautiful


⚠ IMLO QOIDALARI (qisqa sifatlar):

  1) 'E' bilan tugasa - faqat -R/-ST:
     large → larger → the largest
     nice  → nicer  → the nicest

  2) QISQA UNLI + BITTA UNDOSh →
     UNDOSh IKKILANADI:
     big → biGGer → the biGGest
     hot → hoTTer → the hoTTest
     thin → thiNNer → the thiNNest

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IER/-IEST:
     easy → easier → the easiest
     happy → happier → the happiest
     trendy → trendier → the trendiest


⚠ QOIDASIZ ShAKLLAR - YoDLASh ShART:

  good   → better  → the best
  bad    → worse   → the worst
  little → less    → the least
  much/many → more → the most
  far    → further/farther →
           the furthest/farthest

  ⚠ Jadvalda 'good', 'bad', 'little'
  aynan shu qoidasizlar.


⚠ 'THAN' va 'THE':

  QIYoSIYda 'THAN':
     'cheaper THAN the brown skirt'
  ENG YUQORIda 'THE':
     'THE cheapest skirt'

  ⚠ 'more cheaper' - XATO (ikki marta
  qiyoslash).
  ⚠ 'the most cheapest' - XATO.


⚠ KUChAYTIRUVChI SO'ZLAR:

  MUCH cheaper = ancha arzonroq
  FAR more expensive = ancha qimmatroq
  A LOT bigger = ancha kattaroq
  A BIT longer = biroz uzunroq

  ⚠ 'VERY cheaper' - XATO!
  'very' faqat ODDIY sifat bilan.


⚠ TENGLIK VA TENGSIZLIK:

  AS ... AS = ... dek
     'as nice as' = shunchalik chiroyli
  NOT AS ... AS = ... dek emas
     'not as long as' = shunchalik uzun
     emas
  THE SAME ... AS = bir xil
     'the same price as' = bir xil narxda

  ⚠ 22-mashqdagi ro'yxatda uchalasi
  ham bor.


⚠ 'LESS' - QIYoSIYNING AKSI:

  'less expensive' = kamroq qimmat
  = 'cheaper' bilan bir xil ma'no,
  lekin muloyimroq.
examples: Short adjectives: short - shorter than - the shortest
Long adjectives: expensive - more expensive than - the most expensive
big - bigger than - the biggest (the consonant doubles)
large - larger than - the largest (only -r/-st after 'e')
good - better than - the best
bad - worse than - the worst
little - less than - the least
as ... as / not as ... as / the same ... as

topics.topic: Grammar: Making Comparisons — Grammatika: Qiyoslash (21-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  big       biggER THAN      THE biggEST
  short     shortER THAN     THE shortEST
  beautiful MORE beautiful   THE MOST
            THAN             beautiful
  large     largER THAN      THE largEST
  expensive MORE expensive   THE MOST
            THAN             expensive
  long      longER THAN      THE longEST
  bad       WORSE THAN       THE WORST
  good      BETTER THAN      THE BEST
  little    LESS THAN        THE LEAST


⚠ JADVALDAN KO'RINADIGAN QOIDA:

  QISQA (big, short, large, long) →
     -ER / -EST
  UZUN (beautiful, expensive) →
     more / the most
  QOIDASIZ (bad, good, little) →
     yodlash ShART


⚠ IMLOGA DIQQAT:

  big   → biGGer  (undosh ikkilanadi)
  large → largEr  (faqat -r, 'e' bor)
  short → shorter (oddiy)
  long  → longer  (oddiy)

  ⚠ 'long' da 'g' IKKILANMAYDI, chunki
  'ng' - bitta tovush.

topics.topic: Grammar: Making Comparisons — Grammatika: Qiyoslash (23-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
'A PAIR OF' QAYSI SO'ZLAR BILAN:

  ⚠ QOIDA: agar narsa IKKI QISMDAN
  iborat bo'lsa (ikki oyoq, ikki
  qo'l), u HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA turadi
  va sanash uchun 'a pair of' kerak.


'A PAIR OF' BILAN (9 ta):

  boots    - etiklar
  tights   - kolgotki
  jeans    - jinsi shim
  leggings - legginsi
  gloves   - qo'lqoplar
  shorts   - shortik
  trainers - krossovkalar
  socks    - paypoqlar
  shoes    - tuflilar

  ⚠ Bularning hammasi HAR DOIM
  KO'PLIKDA: 'a jean' - XATO,
  'jeans' to'g'ri.


'A PAIR OF' BILAN EMAS (12 ta):

  a belt      - kamar
  a tracksuit - sport kostyumi
  a cardigan  - kofta
  a tie       - galstuk
  a sweatshirt - futbolka (uzun yengli)
  a jumper    - sviter
  a coat      - palto
  a shirt     - ko'ylak
  a skirt     - yubka
  a scarf     - ro'mol
  a jacket    - kurtka, pidjak

  ⚠ Bular BITTA narsa - oddiy artikl
  bilan sanaladi.


⚠ 'TROUSERS' VA 'A TROUSER':

  'trousers' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA -
  'a trouser' XATO.
  ⚠ 18-betda 'a pair of trousers'
  bor edi.


⚠ 'A JUMPER' - MAMLAKATGA QARAB:

  Britaniyada 'a jumper' = sviter.
  AQShda 'a sweater'.
  ⚠ AQShda 'a jumper' - butunlay boshqa
  narsa (sarafan).


⚠ 'TRAINERS' va 'SNEAKERS':

  Britaniyada 'trainers',
  AQShda 'sneakers'.


⚠ 'A SCARF' - KO'PLIGI:

  'a scarf' → 'scarVES'
  ⚠ -f/-fe → -ves: leaf/leaves,
  knife/knives, loaf/loaves.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (4-mashq qoidasi) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
FAKT va FIKR SIFATLARI
  (coursebook 20-bet qoidasi).

  FAKT (F) - o'lchash/ko'rish
  mumkin, hamma rozi:
    big, old, green, small, round,
    wooden
  FIKR (O) - shaxsiy baho, boshqa
  odam boshqacha o'ylashi mumkin:
    lovely, wonderful, excellent,
    beautiful, nice


⚠ TARTIB: FIKR + FAKT:

  'a lovely old house' (fikr →
  fakt). Coursebook 20-bet 12-
  mashq.


GAPLARDAGI SIFATLAR:

  1 big → F (o'lcham)
  2 lovely → O (baho)
  3 wonderful → O (baho)
  4 old → F (yosh)
  5 green → F (rang)
  6 excellent → O (baho)


⚠ 'A PLAY':

  = pyesa, spektakl. 'Romeo and
  Juliet' - Shekspir pyesasi.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (6-mashq qoidasi) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
SIFATLAR TARTIBI (coursebook
  20-bet qoidasi):

  FIKR → O'LChAM → YOSh → ShAKL →
  RANG → MATERIAL + OT

  round (shakl) + rubber (material)
  warm (fikr/xususiyat) + woollen
    (material)
  small (o'lcham) + rubber (material)
  big (o'lcham) + cotton (material)
  old (yosh) + leather (material)
  big (o'lcham) + rectangular (shakl)

  ⚠ MATERIAL HAR DOIM OXIRIDA
  (otdan oldin).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'It's a round rubber basketball.'


⚠ 10 SIFAT, 6 RASM - 'rubber' va
  'big' ikki marta ishlatiladi
  (to'p va o'rdak ikkalasi rezina).


⚠ 'A(N)':

  'It's a(n) ...' - birinchi sifat
  unli bilan boshlansa 'an': 'an
  old leather cowboy boot'.


⚠ 'WOOLLEN':

  = jun (sifat). Brit. ikki 'l'.


⚠ 'RUBBER':

  = rezina. 'a rubber duck' =
  rezina o'rdakcha (hammom
  o'yinchog'i).

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (9-mashq qoidasi) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
TAXMIN - MUST / CAN'T + BE.

  QOLIP:
  She/He MUST be + OT/SIFAT.
  She/He CAN'T be + OT/SIFAT.
  She/He MUST/CAN'T + FE'L (earn,
  work).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'She must be a student. She
   can't be married.'


SURATLAR:

  SARAH - yosh, ryukzak, kundalik
    kiyim → student, 18, single,
    can't earn a lot
  TIMOTHY - kostyum, telefon,
    London markazi → businessman,
    earns a lot, works long hours,
    can't be 18 / a student

  ⚠ 'pilot' - ikkalasiga ham
  'can't be a pilot' (forma yo'q).


⚠ 'SINGLE':

  = bo'ydoq / turmush qurmagan.
  'married' ning aksi.


⚠ 'TO EARN':

  = pul topmoq, ishlab topmoq.


⚠ 'TO WORK LONG HOURS':

  = ko'p soat ishlamoq.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (10-mashq qoidasi) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
QIYOSIY va ORTTIRMA DARAJA
  (coursebook 22-bet qoidasi).

  QIYOSIY (ikki narsa) + THAN:
    qisqa: -ER (heavier, smaller,
      taller, cheaper)
    uzun: MORE + sifat (more
      expensive)
  ORTTIRMA (hammasidan) + THE:
    qisqa: THE -EST (the oldest,
      the biggest)
    uzun: THE MOST + sifat (the
      most beautiful)


⚠ NOQONUNIY:

  good → better → THE BEST
  bad → worse → THE WORST


⚠ KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  'than', 'mine/yours' → QIYOSIY
  'of all', 'in the city/world/
  family' → ORTTIRMA


⚠ IMLO:

  big → biggER, biggEST (undosh
  ikkilanadi)
  heavy → heavIER (y → i)


⚠ 'THAN MINE / YOURS':

  'more expensive than mine' =
  menikidan qimmatroq.

topics.topic: Adjectives - Adverbs — Sifat va ravish (1)
topics.rule_uz:
SIFAT va RAVISh - FARQI.

  SIFAT → OTni tasvirlaydi:
    a SMALL village
  RAVISh → FE'Lni (yoki sifat/
    ravishni) tasvirlaydi:
    He works HARD.
    He runs VERY fast.
    She is EXTREMELY polite.


-ING va -ED SIFATLAR:

  -ING = narsa QANDAY (sabab):
    The film was BORING.
    She is an INTERESTING person.
  -ED = odam QANDAY HIS QILADI
    (natija):
    The children were TERRIFIED.
    I'm BORED. (zerikdim)

  ⚠ 'I'm boring' = men zerikarli
  odamman! 'I'm bored' = zerikdim.


RAVISh O'RNI:

  Fe'ldan KEYIN: She spoke SOFTLY.
  Chastota ravishi fe'ldan OLDIN:
    He ALWAYS drives carefully.
examples: We live in a small village. (adjectives describe nouns)
The film was boring. She is a very interesting person. (-ing: what somebody/something is like)
The children were terrified when they heard the thunder. (-ed: how somebody feels)
He works hard. He runs very fast. She is extremely polite. (adverbs describe verbs, adverbs, adjectives)
She spoke softly. He always drives carefully. (position of adverbs)

topics.topic: Adjectives - Adverbs — Sifat va ravish (2)
topics.rule_uz:
RAVISh YASASh - SIFAT + -LY.

  1) ODDIY: + -ly
     dangerous → dangerousLY
     slow → slowly

  2) -LE: -e → -y
     gentle → gentLY
     terrible → terribly

  3) UNDOSh + Y: -y → -ily
     easy → easILY
     happy → happily

  4) -L: + -ly (ikkita l!)
     wonderful → wonderfulLY
     careful → carefully


MAXSUS ShAKLLAR:

  good → WELL (butunlay boshqa)
  fast → fast    (bir xil)
  hard → hard    (bir xil)
  early → early  (bir xil)
  late → late    (bir xil)

  ⚠ 'He runs fastly' ✗ → 'fast'.
  ⚠ 'hardly' = deyarli emas
  (boshqa ma'no!); 'lately' =
  yaqinda.


⚠ -LY BILAN TUGAYDIGAN SIFATLAR:

  friendly, lively, lonely, lovely,
  silly, ugly - bular RAVISh EMAS:
  He's a FRIENDLY person.
examples: dangerous - dangerously (+ -ly)
gentle - gently (-le → -ly)
easy - easily (consonant + y → -ily)
wonderful - wonderfully (-l + -ly)
good → well; fast → fast; hard → hard; early → early; late → late
friendly, lively, lonely, lovely, silly, ugly = adjectives (He's a friendly person.)

topics.topic: Past Continuous — Past Continuous (o'tgan davomli zamon)
topics.rule_uz:
PAST CONTINUOUS = was / were +
  fe'l-ING.

  TASDIQ:
    I / he / she / it WAS eating
    we / you / they WERE eating

  SO'ROQ (was/were oldinga):
    WAS he eating?
    WERE they eating?

  INKOR:
    I WASN'T eating
    they WEREN'T eating

  QISQA JAVOB:
    Was he eating? - Yes, he WAS. /
    No, he WASN'T.
    Were they eating? - Yes, they
    WERE. / No, they WEREN'T.


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  'yeyayotgan edi' = was eating.
  O'tmishda MA'LUM PAYTDA davom
  etayotgan harakat.

  ⚠ Ishlatilishi keyingi betda
  (21-bet).
examples: I / he / she / it was eating — we / you / they were eating
Was he eating? — Were they eating?
I wasn't eating — they weren't eating
Was he ...? — Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't. — Were they ...? — Yes, they were. / No, they weren't.

topics.topic: Past Continuous - Form and Use — Past Continuous - shakli va ishlatilishi
topics.rule_uz:
PAST CONTINUOUS QAChON - 4 HOLAT.

  1) O'TMIShDA MA'LUM PAYTDA davom
     etayotgan harakat:
     At five o'clock yesterday I
     WAS COOKING dinner.
     (boshi-oxiri noma'lum)

  2) UZUN HARAKAT + QISQA UZILISh:
     She WAS HAVING breakfast
     (uzun - Continuous)
     when the phone RANG
     (qisqa - Simple)

  3) BIR VAQTDA IKKI HARAKAT:
     Tina WAS DOING the washing-up
     WHILE the children WERE
     PLAYING in the garden.

  4) HIKOYADA FON:
     The sun WAS SHINING brightly
     AS Tom WAS DRIVING his brand
     new car ...


BOG'LOVChILAR:

  while / as + Past Continuous
    (uzun)
  when + Past Simple (qisqa)

  ⚠ 'when' + Continuous ham
  mumkin: 'When I was cooking,
  ...'


⚠ 'BRAND NEW':

  = yap-yangi.
examples: I was working. They were working. — Was he working? They weren't working.
At five o'clock yesterday I was cooking dinner. (action in progress at a stated time)
She was having breakfast when the phone rang. (longer action interrupted by shorter action)
Tina was doing the washing-up while the children were playing in the garden. (simultaneous actions)
The sun was shining brightly as Tom was driving his brand new car through the city centre. (background in a story)
while, when, as

topics.topic: Grammar: Adjectives - Adverbs — Grammatika: Sifat va ravish
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  'ADJECTIVES describe NOUNS.
   ADVERBS usually describe VERBS or
   other adverbs.'

  'She was holding a bouquet of PRETTY
   flowers.'  (sifat + ot)
  '"Excuse me," the young woman said
   SWEETLY.'  (fe'l + ravish)


⚠ ASOSIY FARQ:

  SIFAT → QANDAY? (ot haqida)
     'a pretty flower' - qanday gul?

  RAVISh → QANDAY QILIB? (fe'l haqida)
     'she said sweetly' - qanday aytdi?


⚠ RAVISh QANDAY YaSALADI:

  SIFAT + -LY:
     sweet → sweetly
     soft  → softly
     loud  → loudly
     heavy → heavily (undosh + y → -ily)
     terrible → terribly ('-le' → '-ly')


⚠ QOIDASIZ RAVIShLAR:

  good → WELL   (⚠ 'goodly' XATO)
  fast → fast   (o'zgarmaydi)
  hard → hard   (o'zgarmaydi)
  late → late   (o'zgarmaydi)
  early → early (o'zgarmaydi)

  ⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin ma'nosi
  BOShQA: 'deyarli emas'.
     'He works HARD.' = qattiq ishlaydi
     'He HARDLY works.' = deyarli
        ishlamaydi

  ⚠ 'lately' ham boshqa ma'noda:
  'so'nggi paytlarda'.


⚠ -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR:

  friendly, lovely, lonely, silly,
  ugly, likely

  ⚠ Bular SIFAT, ravish EMAS!
  ⚠ Ulardan ravish yasash uchun
  'in a ... way' ishlatiladi:
  'in a friendly way'.


⚠ HIS FE'LLARIDAN KEYIN SIFAT:

  be, look, seem, sound, feel, taste,
  smell, become, get

  ⚠ Bulardan keyin SIFAT keladi,
  ravish EMAS:
     'She looks BEAUTIFUL.'
        ('beautifully' XATO)
     'It sounds GOOD.' ('well' XATO)
     'The food tastes DELICIOUS.'

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'You LOOK as if ...',
  'It SOUNDS like ...'


⚠ HIKOYaDAGI RAVIShLAR:

  heavily  - qattiq (yomg'ir)
  sweetly  - shirin ohangda
  jokingly - hazillashib
  loudly   - baland ovozda
  softly   - ohista
  still    - hamon
  no longer - endi ... emas
examples: Adjectives describe nouns.
Adverbs usually describe verbs or other adverbs.
She was holding a bouquet of pretty flowers.
"Excuse me," the young woman said sweetly.
good → well (irregular); fast, hard, late, early do not change.
After look, seem, sound, feel, taste and smell we use an adjective, not an adverb.

topics.topic: Grammar: Past Continuous — Grammatika: Past Continuous
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI.

  'We form the past continuous with
   WAS/WERE (past tense of the verb
   TO BE) and the PRESENT PARTICIPLE
   of the main verb (verb + ing).'


AFFIRMATIVE (tasdiq):
  I / he / she / it WAS eating
  we / you / they   WERE eating

NEGATIVE (inkor):
  I / he / she / it WASN'T eating
  we / you / they   WEREN'T eating

INTERROGATIVE (so'roq):
  WAS I / he / she / it eating?
  WERE we / you / they eating?

SHORT ANSWERS (qisqa javob):
  Yes, I / he / she / it WAS.
  No, he / she / it WASN'T.
  Yes, we / you / they WERE.
  No, we / you / they WEREN'T.


⚠ 'WAS' va 'WERE' - KIM BILAN:

  WAS  - I, he, she, it
  WERE - we, you, they

  ⚠ DIQQAT: 'I WAS' (hozirgi zamonda
  'I am' bo'lgani kabi), lekin
  'YOU WERE' (hatto bitta odam
  bo'lsa ham).


⚠ -ING QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:

  eat   → eating   (oddiy)
  make  → making   (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  sit   → sitting  (qisqa unli + bitta
                    undosh → IKKILANADI)
  lie   → lying    (-ie → -ying)
  travel → travelling (Britaniyada 'l'
                    ikkilanadi)


⚠ 'A PRESENT PARTICIPLE':

  = -ing shakli.
  ⚠ 'present' bu yerda 'hozirgi zamon'
  emas - shunchaki shaklning nomi.
  ⚠ U past continuous da ham,
  present continuous da ham bir xil.


⚠ TO'RT QO'LLANISh (17-mashq):

  a) IKKI YoKI UNDAN KO'P ish BIR
     VAQTDA:
     'She WAS WEARING a dress and she
      WAS HOLDING flowers.'

  b) HIKOYaNING FONI:
     'It WAS RAINING heavily outside.'

  c) UZUN ishni QISQA ish BO'LDI:
     'She WAS WATCHING TV when the
      doorbell RANG.'

  d) O'TMIShNING ANIQ PAYTIDA davom
     etayotgan ish:
     'It was half past ten and Janice
      WAS WAITING for her husband.'


⚠ 'WHEN' va 'WHILE':

  WHEN + past simple (qisqa ish)
     'when the doorbell rang'
  WHILE + past continuous (uzun ish)
     'while she was watching TV'

  ⚠ Ikkalasi bir gapda:
  'WHILE she was watching TV, the
   doorbell rang.'
  = 'She was watching TV WHEN the
     doorbell rang.'


⚠ HOLAT FE'LLARI CONTINUOUSDA
BO'LMAYDI:

  know, understand, want, like, love,
  hate, need, believe, remember

  ⚠ 'I was knowing' - XATO.
  ⚠ 20-mashqda 'be' fe'li ham SIMPLE
  da qoladi: 'It WAS Christmas Eve.'
examples: Affirmative: I/he/she/it was eating; we/you/they were eating
Negative: I/he/she/it wasn't eating; we/you/they weren't eating
Interrogative: Was I/he/she/it eating? Were we/you/they eating?
Short Answers: Yes, I was. / No, he wasn't. / Yes, they were. / No, we weren't.
-ing spelling: eat → eating, make → making, sit → sitting, lie → lying, travel → travelling

topics.topic: Grammar: Past Continuous — Grammatika: Past Continuous (18-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
OLTI VAQT:

  6 am,    11 am,   7 pm
  8:30 am, 3:30 pm, 10:30 pm


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'At 6 am last Monday I WAS GETTING
   DRESSED.'
  'At the same time last Sunday I WAS
   SLEEPING.'


⚠ QOLIP:

  At [VAQT] last [KUN] I was [fe'l]-ing.
  At the same time last [KUN] I was
  [fe'l]-ing.


⚠ 'AT THE SAME TIME':

  = o'sha vaqtda.
  ⚠ Takrorlamaslik uchun juda qulay
  ibora.


⚠ 'TO GET DRESSED':

  = kiyinmoq.
  ⚠ 'get' + sifat = holat o'zgarishi:
     get dressed - kiyinmoq
     get ready - tayyorlanmoq
     get tired - charchamoq
     get married - turmush qurmoq


⚠ 'AM' va 'PM':

  am = tushgacha (ante meridiem)
  pm = tushdan keyin (post meridiem)

  ⚠ 12 am = yarim tun
  ⚠ 12 pm = tush payti
  ⚠ Bu ikkisi ko'p adashtiriladi.


⚠ FOYDALI FE'LLAR:

  getting up, getting dressed, having
  breakfast, going to school, having
  lessons, having lunch, coming home,
  doing homework, watching TV, having
  dinner, sleeping

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (5-mashq qoidasi) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
SIFAT yoki RAVISh? (coursebook
  28-bet qoidasi)

  SIFAT - OTNI tasvirlaydi:
    heavy footsteps (qanday qadam?)
    He was careful ('be' dan keyin
    SIFAT!)
  RAVISh - FE'LNI tasvirlaydi:
    smiled sweetly (qanday jilmaydi?)
    gently picked up
    closed softly
    did well


⚠ 'BE + SIFAT':

  'He WAS careful' - 'be' fe'lidan
  keyin SIFAT (ravish EMAS).


⚠ 'GOOD' → 'WELL':

  good = sifat, well = ravish.
  'She did WELL' ('did good' -
  XATO).


⚠ 'SUDDENLY' - GAP BOShIDA:

  'Suddenly, they heard ...' -
  ravish butun gapni tasvirlaydi.


⚠ 'A PUPPY':

  = kuchukcha. 'TINY' = mitti.


⚠ 'FOOTSTEPS':

  = qadam tovushlari.


⚠ 'A VASE':

  = guldon. Brit. /vɑːz/.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (7-mashq qoidasi) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
PAST SIMPLE yoki PAST CONTINUOUS?
  (coursebook 29-bet qoidasi)

  PAST CONTINUOUS (was/were +
  V-ing) - DAVOM ETAYOTGAN fon:
    'was lying WHEN she got home'
    'were watching WHEN the pizza
     arrived'
  PAST SIMPLE - QISQA, TUGALLANGAN
  voqea (uzib kiradi):
    'replied', 'sat', 'gasped'

  ⚠ QOLIP: was/were + V-ing WHEN
  + past simple.
  ⚠ 'AS I was getting on' = ...
  ayotganimda.


NOQONUNIY FE'LLAR:

  sit → SAT
  hear → HEARD
  shake → SHOOK
  fall → FELL
  go → WENT
  lie → lying (ie → y!)


⚠ 'TWO YEARS AGO' → PAST SIMPLE.


⚠ 'TO GASP IN AMAZEMENT':

  = hayratdan nafas yutmoq.


⚠ 'A BRIDE':

  = kelin. 'a lace dress' = to'rli
  ko'ylak. 'a bouquet' = guldasta.


⚠ 'TO RESCUE':

  = qutqarmoq. 'on its own' =
  o'zi (yordamsiz).


⚠ 'TO SHAKE ONE'S HEAD':

  = bosh chayqamoq (yo'q).


⚠ 'THE HALL':

  = dahliz, koridor.


⚠ ANKARA:

  = Turkiya poytaxti.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (8-mashq qoidasi) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
PAST CONTINUOUS - QIChQIRIQ
  PAYTIDA KIM NIMA QILAYOTGAN EDI
  (coursebook 29-bet 19-mashq
  kabi).

  QOLIP:
  X WASN'T/WEREN'T + V-ing ...
  He/She/They WAS/WERE + V-ing ...


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Harry wasn't talking to Ali and
   Maya. He was coming down the
   stairs.'


RASMDA:

  Jane - xonaga KIRIB KELYAPTI
  Guide - turistlarga GAPIRYAPTI
    (qo'li bilan ko'rsatyapti)
  Ali, Maya - GIDNI tinglashyapti
  Harry - ZINADAN tushyapti
  Mick - RASMGA qarayapti
  Mr West - QUTI USTIDA o'tiribdi
  Mr Brown - SURATGA olyapti


⚠ 'A TERRIBLE SCREAM':

  = dahshatli qichqiriq. Hikoya
  boshlanishi - 'Suddenly' bilan.


⚠ 'A GUIDE':

  = gid, yo'l boshlovchi.


⚠ 'A CASTLE':

  = qal'a. /ˈkɑːsl/ - 't'
  O'QILMAYDI.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (15-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
HIKOYA BOShLANIShLARI (coursebook
  29-bet 'Beginnings').

  ⚠ QOLIP: AS/WHEN + past
  continuous (fon), past simple
  (voqea).

  1 'as I WAS WALKING' (fon) ...
    'noticed' ... 'He WAS LOOKING'
    (tasvir)
  2 'WAS JUST FINISHING when he
    heard' ... 'he CRIED' (aytdi -
    qisqa)
  3 'WAS LOCKING when I HEARD'
  4 'The sun WAS SHINING when we
    left' ... 'it STARTED raining'
  5 'as I WAS TRAVELLING ... I MET'


⚠ 'HEAR' - CONTINUOUS EMAS:

  'was hearing' - XATO (sezgi
  fe'li).


⚠ 'TO CRY' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) yig'lamoq
  2) qichqirmoq, xitob qilmoq
  ('Oh no!' he cried).


⚠ 'STRANGE-LOOKING':

  = g'alati ko'rinishli.


⚠ 'TO CALL OUT':

  = baland ovozda chaqirmoq.


⚠ 'TO LEAVE FOR':

  = ... ga jo'namoq.

topics.topic: Future Simple — Future Simple (kelasi oddiy zamon)
topics.rule_uz:
FUTURE SIMPLE = WILL + FE'L.

  TASDIQ: I / he / they WILL go
    (hamma shaxsda bir xil)
    Qisqa: I'll, he'll, they'll
  SO'ROQ: WILL she visit us?
  INKOR: She WILL NOT / WON'T
    visit us.
  QISQA JAVOB: Yes, I will. / No,
    I won't.


QAChON - 3 HOLAT:

  1) BAShORAT (fikr):
     Robots WILL DO most of the
     work in the future.

  2) ShU ZAHOTI QAROR / VA'DA:
     A: It's cold in here.
     B: I'LL CLOSE the window.
     (hozir qaror qildim)
     Your father WILL HELP you.
     (va'da)

  3) ILTIMOS - Will you ...?
     WILL YOU post this letter for
     me, please?


VAQT SO'ZLARI:

  tomorrow, the day after tomorrow
  (indinga), next week / month /
  year, tonight, soon (tez orada),
  in a week (bir haftadan keyin)


⚠ 'WILL' DAN KEYIN 'TO' YO'Q:

  'will to go' ✗, 'will goes' ✗.
examples: She will visit us. They will have a party. — Will she visit us? — She won't visit us.
Robots will do most of the work in the future. (prediction)
A: It's cold in here. B: I'll close the window. (on-the-spot decision) — Your father will help you with your homework. (promise)
Will you post this letter for me, please? (request)
Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, next week/month/year, tonight, soon, in a week/month/year

topics.topic: Be going to — Be going to (niyat, reja)
topics.rule_uz:
BE GOING TO = am / is / are +
  going to + FE'L.

  TASDIQ: He IS GOING TO have a
    snack. (U tamaddi qilmoqchi)
  SO'ROQ: IS he going to have a
    snack?
  INKOR: He ISN'T going to have a
    snack.
  QISQA JAVOB: Yes, he is. / No,
    he isn't.


QAChON:

  REJA va NIYAT (oldindan
  o'ylangan):
    Susan IS GOING TO move house.
    (Syuzan ko'chmoqchi - reja)


⚠ WILL va GOING TO FARQI:

  WILL - shu zahoti qaror:
    'It's cold. I'LL close the
    window.'
  GOING TO - oldindan reja:
    'I'M GOING TO close the window
    - I decided this morning.'


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  going to = '-moqchi'
  will = '-adi' / '-aman'
examples: He is going to have a snack. — Is he going to have a snack? — He isn't going to have a snack.
Yes, I am / you are / he is. — No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't.
Susan is going to move house. (plans and intentions for the near future)

topics.topic: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous — Kelajak: will - going to - Present Continuous
topics.rule_uz:
UCh XIL KELAJAK - FARQI.

  WILL - fikrga asoslangan
    bashorat / noaniq:
    She'LL SELL her bicycle.
    (sotishi ham, sotmasligi ham
    mumkin)

  GOING TO - NIYAT yoki KO'RINIB
    TURGAN dalilga asoslangan
    bashorat:
    He'S GOING TO study medicine
    next year. (niyat)
    Look at him. He'S GOING TO jump
    out of the train. (ko'rinib
    turibdi)

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ANIQ
    KELIShUV (vaqt, joy belgilangan):
    They'RE LEAVING for Cairo
    tomorrow.


⚠ QISQAChA:

  will = o'ylayman
  going to = niyatim bor / ko'rib
    turibman
  -ing = kelishib qo'yganman
examples: Look at him. He's going to jump out of the train. (prediction based on what we see)
She'll sell her bicycle. (she may or may not sell it)
He's going to study medicine next year. (intention)
They're leaving for Cairo tomorrow. (fixed arrangement)

topics.topic: Conditionals Type 1 - When/If — 1-tur shart gap - When/If
topics.rule_uz:
1-TUR ShART GAP - REAL KELAJAK.

  IF + PRESENT SIMPLE, + WILL +
  FE'L

  If Tom STUDIES hard, he WILL
  PASS the exam.
  (shart)          (natija)

  ⚠ 'if' qismida 'will' YO'Q:
  'If Tom will study' ✗
  ⚠ O'zbekchada: '-sa' → 'if'.

  Ikki qism o'rin almashishi mumkin:
  He will pass the exam if he
  studies hard. (vergul yo'q)


WHEN va IF FARQI:

  WHEN = -ganda (ALBATTA bo'ladi):
    I'll see you WHEN I come to
    Paris. (Parijga albatta
    kelaman)

  IF = -sa (BALKI bo'ladi):
    I'll see you IF I come to
    Paris. (kelishim noaniq)

  ⚠ Ikkalasidan keyin ham PRESENT
  SIMPLE (will emas!).
examples: If he wakes up late (if-clause: hypothesis), he will miss the bus (main clause: result).
if + present simple → future simple: If Tom studies hard, he will pass the exam.
I'll see you when I come to Paris. (I'm certain I'll come to Paris.)
I'll see you if I come to Paris. (Perhaps I'll come to Paris, perhaps I won't.)

topics.topic: Grammar: Future — Grammatika: Kelasi zamon
topics.rule_uz:
5-UNITNING ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI:
KELASI ZAMONNING UCh ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  1) BE GOING TO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  YaSALIShI:
     am/is/are + going to + FE'L

     I AM going to buy a hat.
     He IS going to fall.
     They ARE going to travel.

  INKOR:
     I'm NOT going to ...
     He ISN'T going to ...

  SAVOL:
     AM I going to ...?
     IS he going to ...?


  QAChON IShLATILADI:

  a) OLDINDAN O'YLANGAN REJA,
     NIYaT
     "I'm going to buy a hat."
     (allaqachon qaror qilgan)

  b) KO'RIB TURGANIMIZGA
     ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN
     "Look at him! He's going to
      fall!"
     (⚠ DALIL KO'Z OLDIMIZDA:
      to'lqinda qiyshayib turibdi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  2) WILL                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  YaSALIShI:
     will + FE'L (BARCha shaxsda bir xil)

     I WILL take these.
     He WILL get warmer.

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q:
     'will TO take' - XATO!

  QISQARTMA:
     I'll, you'll, he'll, we'll, they'll
     INKOR: won't (= will not)


  QAChON IShLATILADI:

  a) ShU ONDA QABUL QILINGAN QAROR
     (on-the-spot decision)
     "I'LL TAKE these, please."
     (bozorda ko'rdi - shu zahoti
      qaror qildi)

  b) O'YLAGANIMIZGA yoki
     TASAVVUR QILGANIMIZGA
     ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN
     'I THINK the weather WILL get
      warmer soon.'
     (⚠ DALIL YO'Q - shunchaki
      fikr, taxmin)

  ⚠ 'I think', 'I'm sure', 'I hope',
  'probably', 'maybe' - HAMMASI
  'will' bilan yuradi.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  3) PRESENT CONTINUOUS           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = ANIQ, KELIShILGAN reja
    (a fixed arrangement)

  "She's MOVING house ON TUESDAY."
  "I'M GETTING a job next summer."

  ⚠ Odatda VAQT ko'rsatiladi
  (on Tuesday, next summer,
   at 7 o'clock).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG MUHIM FARQ                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'RIB TURIBMAN → be going to
     "Look at those clouds!
      It's GOING TO rain."

  O'YLAYMAN → will
     "I think it WILL rain
      tomorrow."

  ShU ZAHOTI QAROR → will
     (Telefon jiringlaydi)
     "I'LL answer it!"

  OLDINDAN QAROR → be going to
     "I'M GOING TO answer all my
      emails tonight."
examples: be going to
will
Look at him! He's going to fall!
I'll take these, please.
I think the weather will get warmer soon.
I'm going to buy a hat.
won't

topics.topic: Grammar: Future — Grammatika: Kelasi zamon (12-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
QUTIDAGI TO'RT BO'Sh JOY.


TO'LIQ QOIDA:

  • We use BE GOING TO to talk about
    FUTURE PLANS and INTENTIONS.
    We also use BE GOING TO to make
    PREDICTIONS based on WHAT WE
    CAN SEE.

  • We use WILL for ON-THE-SPOT
    DECISIONS. We also use WILL to
    make PREDICTIONS based on WHAT
    WE THINK OR IMAGINE.


⚠ ESLAB QOLISh USULI:

  KO'Z bilan ko'rsam → going to
  MIYa bilan o'ylasam → will

topics.topic: Grammar: Future — Grammatika: Kelasi zamon (14-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
'BE GOING TO' - TASDIQ va INKOR.


QOLIP:
  I'm going to [fe'l].
  I'm not going to [fe'l].


O'NTA KO'RSATMA:

  walk home       - piyoda uyga bormoq
  drive home      - mashinada uyga
                    bormoq
  go shopping     - xaridga bormoq
  have a snack    - yengil tamaddi
                    qilmoq
  visit friends   - do'stlarni yo'qlamoq
  listen to music - musiqa tinglamoq
  do your homework - uy vazifasini
                    bajarmoq
  watch a film    - film ko'rmoq
  clean your house - uyni tozalamoq
  get some exercise - biroz mashq
                    qilmoq


⚠ 'YOUR' → 'MY':

  Ro'yxatda 'do YOUR homework' deb
  turibdi, lekin O'ZINGIZ haqingizda
  gapirganda 'do MY homework'
  bo'ladi.


⚠ 'TO WALK HOME' - PREDLOGSIZ:

  ⚠ 'walk TO home' - XATO!
  'home' bu yerda RAVISh.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'go home',
  'drive home', 'get home'.


⚠ 'A SNACK':

  = yengil tamaddi (sendvich, meva).
  ⚠ 'to HAVE a snack' - 'to eat' emas.


⚠ 'TO GET SOME EXERCISE':

  ⚠ 'exercise' bu ma'noda
  SANALMAYDIGAN → 'some'.
  ⚠ Lekin mashq-topshiriq ma'nosida
  sanaladi: 'exercise 5'.

topics.topic: Grammar: Future — Grammatika: Kelasi zamon (16b-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
UCh KO'RSATMA - HAR DIALOG UChUN.


⚠ 1-DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A: What are your plans for [vaqt]?
  B: We're going to go to [joy].
  A: Wow! When are you leaving?
  B: On [sana].


⚠ 2-DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A: It's very [ob-havo sifati] today.
  B: Yes. It's going to [ob-havo
     fe'li].


⚠ 3-DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A: Which extra [fan turi] are you
     going to study next year?
  B: I'm not sure yet, but I think
     I'll do [ikki fan].


⚠ 'SWITZERLAND':

  = Shveytsariya.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈswɪtsələnd/.
  ⚠ Sifati: 'Swiss'
  ('Switzerlandish' XATO).


⚠ 'SPANISH' va 'RUSSIAN':

  ⚠ Til nomlari HAR DOIM KATTA harf
  bilan.
  ⚠ 'languages' - '-ge' + '-s'.

topics.topic: Grammar: Conditionals Type 1 — Grammatika: 1-tur shart gaplari (1)
topics.rule_uz:
1-TUR ShART GAPLARI
(CONDITIONALS TYPE 1).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  WILL + INFINITIVE (to SIZ)

     IF you DON'T HURRY UP,
     you WILL MISS the bus.

     IF I HAVE enough money,
     I'LL MOVE to a bigger house.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG KATTA XATO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ⚠ 'IF' dan keyin 'WILL' IShLATMANG!

     ✗ If you will hurry up, ...
     ✓ If you HURRY UP, ...

  ⚠ 'if' bo'lagida PRESENT SIMPLE,
  asosiy gapda 'will'.

  ⚠ Bu o'zbek tilidan farq qiladi:
  o'zbekchada IKKALA bo'lakda ham
  kelasi zamon bo'lishi mumkin.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QAChON IShLATILADI              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAQIQIY yoki JUDA EhTIMOLLI
  vaziyatlar - hozir yoki kelajakda.

  ⚠ 'If it rains, I'll stay at home.'
  (yomg'ir yog'ishi ehtimoli bor)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  VERGUL QOIDASI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'if' bo'lagi OLDIN kelsa - VERGUL:
     'If it rains, I'll stay home.'

  'if' bo'lagi KEYIN kelsa - VERGUL
  YO'Q:
     'I'll stay home if it rains.'


⚠ 'INFINITIVE WITHOUT TO':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv, ya'ni fe'lning
  ASOSIY shakli.
  ⚠ 'will TO miss' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'will MISS' ✓


⚠ 'TO HURRY UP':

  = shoshilmoq.
  ⚠ 'Hurry up!' = Tezroq!


⚠ 'PROBABLE':

  = ehtimolli.
  ⚠ 'probably' = ehtimol (ravish).
examples: If you don't hurry up, you will miss the bus.
If I have enough money, I'll move to a bigger house.
Form: IF + present simple, WILL + infinitive without to
We use conditionals type 1 to talk about real or very probable situations in the present or future.
NOT: If you will hurry up, ...

topics.topic: Grammar: Conditionals Type 1 — Grammatika: 1-tur shart gaplari (23b-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: What WILL you DO if you
      HAVEN'T GOT any money?
  SB: If I HAVEN'T GOT any money,
      I'LL BORROW some.


⚠ SAVOL QOLIPI:

  What will you do if + PRESENT
  SIMPLE?

  ⚠ Savolda ham 'if' dan keyin
  PRESENT SIMPLE!


⚠ JAVOB QOLIPI:

  If + PRESENT SIMPLE, I'll + FE'L.


⚠ "HAVEN'T GOT":

  = 'don't have' (Britaniya
  so'zlashuvi).
  ⚠ 'I haven't got any money' =
  'I don't have any money'.


⚠ 'ANY' va 'SOME':

  INKORDA 'any': 'haven't got ANY
     money'
  TASDIQDA 'some': "I'll borrow
     SOME"

  ⚠ 'some' bu yerda 'some money'
  o'rnida - ot TAKRORLANMAYDI.

topics.topic: Grammar: Conditionals Type 1 — Grammatika: 1-tur shart gaplari (24-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
ZANJIRLI ShART GAPLARI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: If Jack DOESN'T HEAR his alarm
      clock, he WON'T WAKE UP.
  S2: If he DOESN'T WAKE UP, ...


⚠ ZANJIR QOIDASI:

  Har gapning ikkinchi qismi keyingi
  gapning BIRINChI qismiga aylanadi.

     ... he won't wake up.
     If he doesn't wake up, ...

  ⚠ "won't wake up" → "doesn't wake
  up" - ShAKL O'ZGARADI!


TO'LIQ ZANJIR:

  Jack/not hear his alarm clock
     → he/not wake up
     → he/be late for his interview
     → he/not get the job
     → he/not earn any money
     → he/spend his savings
     → he/be in big trouble!


⚠ 'AN ALARM CLOCK':

  = budilnik.
  ⚠ 'to set an alarm' = budilnikni
  qo'ymoq.


⚠ 'AN INTERVIEW':

  = suhbat (ishga qabul).
  ⚠ 'a job interview'.


⚠ 'SAVINGS':

  = jamg'arma.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
  ⚠ 'a saving' - bu ma'noda ishlatilmaydi.


⚠ 'TO BE IN BIG TROUBLE':

  = katta muammoga tushmoq.
  ⚠ 'trouble' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  shuning uchun 'a big trouble' XATO.


⚠ 'TO EARN':

  = ishlab topmoq (pul).
  ⚠ 'to win' = yutmoq (o'yin, lotereya).
  ⚠ ADAShTIRMANG!

topics.topic: Grammar: Conditionals Type 1 — Grammatika: 1-tur shart gaplari (2)
topics.rule_uz:
'WHEN' va 'IF' FARQI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHEN = ANIQ bo'ladi             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'WHEN I go into town, I'll buy you
   a newspaper.'

  ⚠ Men shaharga ALBATTA boraman -
  faqat qachonligi noma'lum.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IF = ANIQ EMAS                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'IF I go into town, I'll buy you
   a newspaper.'

  ⚠ Men shaharga borishim ham,
  bormasligim ham mumkin.


⚠ IKKALASIDAN KEYIN HAM PRESENT
   SIMPLE:

  ✗ When I WILL go into town, ...
  ✓ When I GO into town, ...

  ⚠ 'when' KELAJAK haqida bo'lsa ham
  PRESENT SIMPLE!

  ⚠ Lekin 'when' SAVOL bo'lsa,
  'will' bo'ladi:
     'WHEN WILL you go into town?'


⚠ ESLAB QOLISh:

  ALBATTA bo'ladi → when
  BALKI bo'lar → if
examples: We use when to show that something will certainly happen.
When I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.
We use if when we are not certain that something will happen.
If I go into town, I'll buy you a newspaper.
NOT: When I will go into town, ...

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (6-mashq qoidasi) (3)
topics.rule_uz:
'BE GOING TO' - DALILGA ASOSLANGAN
  BAShORAT (coursebook 36-bet
  qoidasi).

  Vaziyat → nima bo'lishi aniq:
  1 iflos pichoq-vilka → ofitsiant
    ularni ALMAShTIRADI (replace
    them)
  2 kimyoviy tozalash tayyor → olib
    KETADI (pick it up)
  3 go'shtni yomon ko'radi →
    VEGETARIAN bo'ladi
  4 sarguzasht ta'tili → RAFTINGGA
    boradi
  5 hayot saqlash, xavfdan
    qo'rqmaydi → O'T O'ChIRUVChI
    bo'ladi

  ⚠ 'make a reservation' -
  ORTIQChA (6 ibora, 5 gap).


⚠ 'DRY CLEANING':

  = kimyoviy tozalash (kiyim).


⚠ 'WHITEWATER RAFTING':

  = tog' daryosida rezina qayiqda
  suzish (ekstremal sport).


⚠ 'TO COMPLAIN':

  = shikoyat qilmoq. 'has
  complained' - present perfect.


⚠ 'A FIREFIGHTER':

  = o't o'chiruvchi (= fireman).

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (7-mashq qoidasi) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
'BE GOING TO' - REJA.

  QOLIP: They're going to + FE'L +
  ...

  ⚠ 'the Smiths' = Smitlar oilasi →
  'They'.


⚠ 'TO SEND INVITATIONS':

  = taklifnomalar yubormoq.


⚠ 'TO DECORATE':

  = bezatmoq. 'balloons' = sharlar.


⚠ 'TO ORGANISE A PARTY':

  = bazm uyushtirmoq.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (9-mashq qoidasi) (3)
topics.rule_uz:
'WILL' - ShU ONDA QAROR / TAKLIF
  (coursebook 36-bet qoidasi).

  Muammo eshitildi → darhol taklif:
  'I'LL + fe'l'.

  1 mashina buzildi → supermarketga
    olib boraman (d)
  2 sovuq → derazani yopaman (e)
  3 qalam yo'qoldi → bitta beraman
    (a)
  4 bel og'riyapti → shifokorga
    qo'ng'iroq qilaman (f)
  5 och → sendvich qilaman (c)
  6 jemper iflos → yuvib beraman
    (b)


⚠ 'I'LL' = 'I WILL':

  Og'zaki nutqda qisqartma.


⚠ 'MY BACK HURTS':

  = belim og'riyapti. 'to hurt' =
  og'rimoq.


⚠ 'HAS BROKEN DOWN':

  = buzilib qoldi (present
  perfect).

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (13-mashq qoidasi) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
1-TUR ShART - O'Z JAVOBINGIZ.

  QOLIP: If I + PRESENT, I will +
  fe'l.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'If I go to Paris, I will visit
   the Eiffel Tower.'


⚠ 'A STOMACH ACHE':

  = qorin og'rig'i. /ˈstʌmək eɪk/.


⚠ 'TO DO WELL IN EXAMS':

  = imtihonlarni yaxshi topshirmoq.


⚠ 'TO MISS THE BUS':

  = avtobusga kech qolmoq.

topics.topic: Some - Any / Much - Many / A Few - A Little / Phrases of Quantity — Some - Any / Much - Many / A Few - A Little / Miqdor iboralari (1)
topics.rule_uz:
SOME va ANY - BIR OZ / BIROR.

  SOME - TASDIQ:
    I want SOME strawberries
    (ko'plik) and SOME ice cream
    (sanalmaydigan).

  SOME - TAKLIF va SO'ROV (savol
  bo'lsa ham!):
    Would you like SOME orange
    juice? (taklif)
    Can I have SOME milk, please?
    (so'rov)

  ANY - INKOR va SO'ROQ:
    There isn't ANY salt left.
    Have you got ANY biscuits?


⚠ SAVOLDA SOME yoki ANY?

  Oddiy savol → ANY (bormi?)
  Taklif / so'rov → SOME ('ha'
  javobini kutamiz)
examples: I want some strawberries and some ice cream. (affirmative)

topics.topic: Giving Advice - Should / Shouldn't — Maslahat berish - Should / Shouldn't
topics.rule_uz:

  SHOULD + fe'l = qilish kerak
    (yaxshi fikr):
    You SHOULD eat plenty of fruit
    and vegetables.

  SHOULDN'T + fe'l = qilmaslik

You shouldn't eat junk food. (= It isn't a good idea)

topics.topic: Conditionals Type 0 - Time Words — 0-tur shart gap - Vaqt so'zlari
topics.rule_uz:
0-TUR ShART GAP - HAR DOIM TO'G'RI.

  IF + PRESENT SIMPLE, + PRESENT
  SIMPLE (ikkala qism ham!)

  If the temperature FALLS below
  0°C, water TURNS into ice.
  (tabiat qonuni - har doim)

  IF = WHEN (= whenever, har
  safar):
  If/When the sun SHINES, snow
  MELTS.

  ⚠ 1-TUR bilan FARQI:
  0-tur: har doim to'g'ri → present
  1-tur: kelajakdagi bir holat →
  will


VAQT SO'ZLARI - WILL YO'Q!

  before, after, while, until, as
  soon as, when dan keyin PRESENT
  SIMPLE:
  I'll wait for you UNTIL you
  FINISH. (until you'll finish ✗)

  ⚠ ISTISNO - 'when' SAVOL SO'ZI
  bo'lsa, will bo'ladi:
  WHEN WILL he arrive? (qachon?)
  I can't tell you WHEN it WILL be
  ready. (qachon - savol)
  LEKIN: Please give me a call
  WHEN you FINISH work. (vaqt
  so'zi - present)


⚠ 'TO MELT':

  = erimoq.


⚠ 'AS SOON AS':

  = ... bilanoq, ... zahoti.
examples: If the temperature falls below 0°C, water turns into ice. (always true)
If/When the sun shines, snow melts. (when = whenever)
I'll wait for you until you finish. (NOT: until you'll finish)
When will he arrive? I can't tell you when it will be ready. (when = question word → future simple)
Please give me a call when you finish work. (when = time word → present simple)

topics.topic: Grammar: Countable/Uncountable Nouns — Grammatika: Sanaladigan/sanalmaydigan otlar (12-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
UCh GURUH.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗

║  (undosh tovush)                 ║

╔══════════════════════════════════╗

║  SANALMAYDIGAN                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'PLIK (sanaladigan):
     some sweets, some chips,

     some grapes

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     some pasta, some orange juice,
     some tea, some coffee,
     some milk, some bacon


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  SANALADIGAN → 'a/an' (birlikda),
     '-s' (ko'plikda)
  SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a/an' YO'Q,
     '-s' YO'Q, 'some' bilan

  ⚠ 'a milk' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'milks' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'some milk' ✓


⚠ 'A' yoki 'AN'?

  ⚠ TOVUShga qarab, HARFga emas!
     an Apple (a - unli)
     an Apricot (a - unli)
     a Hamburger (h - undosh)
     a Hot dog (h - undosh)

  ⚠ 'a Uniform' - 'u' /juː/ deb
