╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  decide, want, would like, would
  love, begin, refuse, agree,
  expect
  stop (to do sth else) = boshqa
    ish qilish uchun to'xtamoq
  remember (not forget) = unutmaslik
  forget (not remember) = qilishni
    unutmoq

  'I decided TO GO.'
  'I would like TO VISIT.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + -ING ShAKLI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  love, like, hate, don't mind,
  look forward to, enjoy, couldn't
  help, can't stand
  stop (finish, give up) = tashlamoq
  remember (recall) = eslamoq
  forget (not recall) = eslamaslik

  'I enjoy WALKING.'
  'I'm looking forward to SEEING
   you.' ⚠ 'to' dan keyin -ing!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  + 'TO'SIZ INFINITIV             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  make, let, can, must, may, could,
  will, would

  'She made me LAUGH.'
  'Let me GO.'
  'I can SWIM.'


⚠ STOP - IKKI MA'NO:

  stop TO smoke = chekish uchun
    to'xtadi
  stop SMOKING = chekishni tashladi


⚠ REMEMBER - IKKI MA'NO:

  remember TO lock = qulflashni
    unutma
  remember LOCKING = qulflaganimni
    eslayman


⚠ FORGET - IKKI MA'NO:

  forgot TO send = yuborishni
    unutdim (yubormadim)
  forgot SENDING = yuborganimni
    unutdim (yuborgan edim)


⚠ 'TO REFUSE':

  = rad etmoq.


⚠ 'TO EXPECT':

  = kutmoq.
examples: + to-infinitive: decide, want, would like, would love, begin, stop (stop briefly to do sth else), remember (not forget), refuse, agree, expect, forget (not remember)
-ing form: love, like, hate, don't mind, look forward to, enjoy, couldn't help, can't stand, stop (finish, give up), remember (recall), forget (not recall)
infinitive without to: make, let, can, must, may, could, will, would

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (7-mashq qoidasi) (4)
topics.rule_uz:
INFINITIV / -ING (coursebook
  94-bet qoidasi).

  LET + kishi + FE'L (to siz):
    'won't let us watch'
  AGREE + TO + fe'l: 'agreed to
    help'
  CAN'T HELP + V-ING: 'couldn't
    help laughing'
  MUST + FE'L (to siz): 'must
    visit'
  REMEMBER + TO + fe'l: 'remember
    to lock'
  DECIDE + TO + fe'l: 'decided to
    give up'
  LOOK FORWARD TO + V-ING: 'looking
    forward to going'
  LOVE + V-ING: 'loves painting'

  1 → b, 2 → f, 3 → h, 4 → a,
  5 → e, 6 → d, 7 → g, 8 → c


⚠ 'CAN'T HELP + V-ING':

  = o'zini tiya olmaslik.
  'couldn't help laughing' =
  kulishdan o'zini tiyolmadi.


⚠ 'TO GIVE UP':

  = tashlamoq (odat).


⚠ 'THE TAJ MAHAL':

  = Toj Mahal (Hindiston).

topics.topic: Reported Speech — Ko'chirma gap
topics.rule_uz:
TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI NUTQ va
  KO'ChIRMA GAP.

  TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI (aynan so'zlar,
  qo'shtirnoq):
    "I want to help," Mary said.

  KO'ChIRMA (ma'no, qo'shtirnoqsiz):
    Mary said (THAT) she wanted to
    help.

  'that' - ixtiyoriy (bo'lsa ham,
  bo'lmasa ham bo'ladi).


ZAMON O'ZGARMAYDI - 2 HOLAT:

  1) Kirish fe'li HOZIRGI zamonda
     (says):
     She SAYS 'I love animals.' →
     She SAYS (that) she LOVES
     animals.

  2) UMUMIY HAQIQAT:
     'Rhinos LIVE in Africa,' said
     the teacher. → The teacher
     said rhinos LIVE in Africa.
     (hozir ham yashaydi)


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  Ko'chirma gap = '-ini aytdi':
  'yordam bermoqchi ekanini aytdi'.


⚠ 'A RHINO':

  = karkidon (rhinoceros).
examples: 'I want to help,' Mary said. (direct speech - quotation marks)
Mary said (that) she wanted to help. (reported speech - no quotation marks)
She says 'I love animals.' → She says (that) she loves animals. (introductory verb in the present - no change)
'Rhinos live in eastern and southern Africa,' said the teacher. → The teacher said (that) rhinos live in Africa. (general truth - no change)

topics.topic: Reported Statements — Ko'chirma darak gaplar
topics.rule_uz:
KO'ChIRMA DARAK GAP - 3 O'ZGARISh.

  1) OLMOShLAR (ma'noga qarab):
     Ed said, "I live in Belfast."
     → Ed said (that) HE lived in
       Belfast.
     I → he/she; my → his/her; me →
     him/her; you → I/me ...

  2) ZAMON - BIR QADAM ORQAGA
     (kirish fe'li o'tgan zamonda):
     Present Simple → Past Simple
       "I WANT" → he WANTED
     Present Continuous → Past
       Continuous
       "She IS PLAYING" → she WAS
       PLAYING
     Present Perfect → Past Perfect
       "They HAVE BOUGHT" → they
       HAD BOUGHT
     Past Simple → Past Perfect
       "He SENT" → he HAD SENT
     Future (will) → WOULD
       "I'LL ORDER" → he WOULD
       ORDER

  3) VAQT SO'ZLARI:
     today/tonight → that day/that
       night
     now → then
     yesterday → the day before
     last week → the previous week
     tomorrow → the following/next
       day
     next week → the following week
     two days ago → two days before
     this/these → that/those


⚠ 'BELFAST':

  = Shimoliy Irlandiya poytaxti.
examples: Ed said, 'I live in Belfast.' → Ed said (that) he lived in Belfast. (pronouns change)
'I want to go out,' he said. → He said (that) he wanted to go out. (Present Simple → Past Simple)
'She is playing in the garden,' he said. → He said (that) she was playing in the garden. (Present Continuous → Past Continuous)
'They have bought a new house,' he said. → He said (that) they had bought a new house. (Present Perfect → Past Perfect)
'He sent me flowers,' she said. → She said (that) he had sent her flowers. (Past Simple → Past Perfect)
'I'll order a new fridge,' he said. → He said (that) he would order a new fridge. (Future Simple → would)
today → that day; now → then; yesterday → the day before; tomorrow → the following day; ago → before; this → that

topics.topic: Say - Tell
topics.rule_uz:
SAY va TELL - FARQI.

  SAY - olmoshsiz (yoki 'to' +
  olmosh):
    Tom SAID (that) he needed help.
    Tom SAID TO ME (that) ...
    (kamroq)

  TELL - HAR DOIM + KIM (to siz!):
    Tom TOLD ME (that) he needed
    help.

  ⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
    'Tom told TO me' ✗
    'Tom said me' ✗

  QISQAChA:
    said (that) ... / said TO me
    told ME (that) ...
examples: Tom said, 'I need some help.' → Tom said (that) he needed some help. (say without a pronoun)
Tom said to me (that) he needed some help. (say + to + pronoun - less common)
Tom told me (that) he needed some help. (tell + pronoun, never 'to')

topics.topic: Reported Questions — Ko'chirma savollar
topics.rule_uz:
KO'ChIRMA SAVOLLAR - ASKED / WANTED
  TO KNOW.

  ⚠ 3 QOIDA:
  1) So'z tartibi TASDIQ (ega +
     fe'l), 'do/does/did' yo'q
  2) Savol belgisi (?) yo'q
  3) Zamon, olmosh o'zgaradi (darak
     gapdagidek)


1) SAVOL SO'ZI BOR (where, what,
   when, why, who):
   "Where DO YOU LIVE?" she asked.
   → She asked me WHERE I LIVED.
   (do yo'q, tasdiq tartib, lived)

2) HA/YO'Q SAVOLI (do, is, have,
   can, will ...):
   "HAVE YOU GOT a pet?" he asked.
   → He asked me IF / WHETHER I
     HAD a pet.
   (if / whether = -mi, -yo'qligini)


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  'qayerda yashashimni so'radi'
  'bor-yo'qligini so'radi'
examples: Reported questions: ask / want to know; verb in the affirmative; no question mark
'Where do you live?' she asked me. → She asked me where I lived. (question word)
'Have you got a pet?' he asked me. → He asked me if/whether I had a pet. (yes/no question)

topics.topic: Grammar: Reported Statements — Grammatika: Ko'chirma darak gaplar
topics.rule_uz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP QOIDALARI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ZAMON O'ZGARIShI                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Reporting verb HOZIRGI zamonda
  (says) → zamonlar O'ZGARMAYDI.
  Reporting verb O'TGAN zamonda
  (said) → zamonlar O'ZGARADI
  (bir qadam orqaga):

  present simple → past simple
    is → was
  present continuous → past
  continuous
    is raining → was raining
  present perfect → past perfect
    has gone → had gone
  past simple → past perfect
    left → had left
  will → would
    will join → would join


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SAY yoki TELL?                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SAY - olmoshsiz yoki 'TO' bilan:
    He SAID (that) ...
    He SAID TO ME (that) ... (kam)
  TELL - har doim OLMOSh BILAN,
  'to' YO'Q:
    He TOLD US (that) ...

  ⚠ 'He told that' ✗
  ⚠ 'He said me' ✗
  ⚠ 'He told to me' ✗


⚠ 'HEAVILY':

  = kuchli (yomg'ir).
  'raining heavily' = jala.


⚠ 'AN ACTION GROUP':

  = faollar guruhi.
examples: When the reporting verb is in the present tense, the verb tenses from direct speech do not change in reported speech.
When the reporting verb is in the past tense, the verb tenses in direct speech change in reported speech.

We use say with or without a personal pronoun. We use to after say when there is a personal pronoun. "It's raining heavily," he said. He said (that) it was raining heavily. He said to me (that) it was raining heavily. (less common)
We always use tell with a personal pronoun. We never use to with tell. He told us (that) it was raining heavily.

topics.topic: Grammar: Reported Statements — Grammatika: Ko'chirma darak gaplar (10-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 told (us)
  2 said (olmoshsiz)
  3 told (me)
  4 said (olmoshsiz - 'that')
  5 said (to me)
  6 told (me)


⚠ QOIDA:
  olmosh BOR, 'to' YO'Q → TOLD
  olmosh YO'Q → SAID
  'to' + olmosh → SAID


⚠ 'LEFT' (bu yerda):

  = qolgan. 'only 1,000 pandas
  LEFT' = faqat 1000 panda qolgan.

topics.topic: Reporting General Truths — Umumiy haqiqatlarni ko'chirish
topics.rule_uz:
UMUMIY HAQIQATLAR - ZAMON
O'ZGARMAYDI!

  'Parrots LIVE in Mexico' - bu har
  doim to'g'ri (fakt).
  → 'He said that parrots LIVE in
    Mexico.' - 'lived' EMAS!

  ⚠ Faktlar, tabiat qonunlari,
  odatlar - hozirgi zamonda qoladi.


⚠ 'A GENERAL TRUTH':

  = umumiy haqiqat, fakt.


⚠ 'ALWAYS TRUE':

  = har doim to'g'ri.
examples: When we report something which is always true the verb tense is the same as in direct speech.
"Green-cheeked parrots live in Mexico." → He said that green-cheeked parrots live in Mexico.

topics.topic: Grammar: Reported Questions — Grammatika: Ko'chirma savollar
topics.rule_uz:
KO'ChIRMA SAVOLLAR.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WH-SAVOLLAR                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ask + WH- + EGA + FE'L
  'Where do you live?' →
  'She asked WHERE I LIVED.'

  ⚠ So'roq so'zi (where, what, how)
  SAQLANADI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  HA/YO'Q SAVOLLAR                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ask + IF + EGA + FE'L
  'Have you got a pet?' →
  'She asked IF I HAD a pet.'

  ⚠ So'roq so'zi yo'q → 'IF'
  (yoki 'whether') qo'shiladi.


⚠ UMUMIY QOIDALAR:

  1 SO'Z TARTIBI - darak gapdek:
    EGA + FE'L ('where I lived' -
    'where did I live' EMAS!)
  2 'do/does/did' YO'QOLADI.
  3 SO'ROQ BELGISI YO'Q.
  4 ZAMON bir qadam orqaga:
    live → lived; have got → had.
  5 OLMOSh o'zgaradi: you → I.


⚠ 'TO DIFFER FROM':

  = ...dan farq qilmoq.
examples: Wh-questions: In reported speech the word order is: ask/etc + wh- + subject + verb. "Where do you live?" → She asked (me) where I lived.
Yes/No questions: In reported speech the word order is: ask/etc + if + subject + verb. "Have you got a pet?" → She asked (me) if I had a pet.
Difference: wh-questions keep the question word; Yes/No questions add 'if'. Both use statement word order and no question mark.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (5-mashq qoidasi) (3)
topics.rule_uz:
SAY / TELL (coursebook 100-bet
  qoidasi).

  SAID (+ to sb) - kimga
    aytilgani SHART EMAS:
    'the guide SAID to the visitors'
    'Ben SAID that'
    'the vet SAID'
  TOLD + KIShI (majburiy!):
    'the expert TOLD us'
    'my parents TOLD me'

  ⚠ 'told' dan keyin HAR DOIM kishi
  (me, us, him ...). 'said' dan
  keyin 'to' + kishi yoki hech
  narsa.


⚠ 'A WILDLIFE EXPERT':

  = yovvoyi tabiat mutaxassisi.


⚠ 'FACING EXTINCTION':

  = yo'qolib ketish arafasida.


⚠ 'THE ENTRANCE':

  = kirish joyi.

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (9-mashq qoidasi) (7)
topics.rule_uz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP XATOLARI.

  1a so'roq tartibi XATO →
     'what THE TIME WAS' (gap
     tartibi)
  1b 'told' + kishi kerak → 'I told
     HIM' / 'I SAID that'
  2a savol 'that' bilan EMAS →
     'asked me IF I had'
  2b 'said her' XATO → 'TOLD her'
  3a 'said Joanne if' XATO → 'ASKED
     Joanne if'
  3b 'she told' (kishisiz) XATO →
     'she SAID'
  4a so'roq tartibi XATO → 'why HE
     HAD done that'
  4b zamon XATO → 'he HADN'T done'
     (past perfect)


⚠ ASOSIY QOIDALAR:

  say (to sb) / tell SB
  ask sb IF / WH- + gap tartibi
  zamon bir qadam orqaga

topics.topic: Reported Instructions/Commands — Ko'chirma ko'rsatma va buyruqlar
topics.rule_uz:
KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ / KO'RSATMA.

  QOLIP:
    ask / tell / order + KIMGA +
    (not) + TO + FE'L

  TASDIQ BUYRUQ:
    "Be polite with the customers,"
    he said.
    → He TOLD me TO BE polite with
      the customers.

  INKOR BUYRUQ:
    "Don't talk so much, please,"
    he said to me.
    → He ASKED me NOT TO TALK so
      much.

  ⚠ 'Don't' → NOT TO + fe'l
    (didn't ✗, to not ✗).
  ⚠ 'please' bo'lsa → ASKED
    (iltimos), qattiq buyruq →
    ORDERED, oddiy → TOLD.
  ⚠ Zamon o'zgarmaydi - to-infinitiv
    zamonsiz.


⚠ 'POLITE':

  = xushmuomala, odobli.
examples: 'Be polite with the customers,' he said. → He told me to be polite with the customers.
'Don't talk so much, please,' he said to me. → He asked me not to talk so much.

topics.topic: Exclamations — Undov gaplar
topics.rule_uz:
UNDOV GAPLAR - 3 QOLIP.

  1) WHAT + A/AN (+ sifat) + BIRLIK
     SANALADIGAN OT
     What A beautiful day!
     What AN experience!

  2) WHAT (+ sifat) + SANALMAYDIGAN
     / KO'PLIK OT (a/an YO'Q)
     What interesting news!
     What terrible mistakes!

  3) HOW + SIFAT / RAVISh
     How pretty she is!
     How fast he runs!

  ⚠ 'What' - OT bilan; 'How' -
    SIFAT/RAVISh bilan.
  ⚠ 'news' - sanalmaydi → 'What
    interesting news!' (a ✗).
  ⚠ HOW dan keyin ega + fe'l:
    How pretty SHE IS! (savol
    tartibi emas).


⚠ 'ADMIRATION':

  = hayrat, zavqlanish.
examples: What a beautiful day! / What an experience!
What interesting news! / What terrible mistakes!
How pretty she is! / How fast he runs!

topics.topic: Question Tags — Ajratilgan savollar (question tags) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
QUESTION TAGS - GAP OXIRIDAGI
  QISQA SAVOL ('shundaymi?').

  MAQSAD: tasdiqlash yoki
  tekshirish.
    Dogs swim, DON'T THEY?
    Your father is a farmer, ISN'T
    HE?

  SHAKLI:
  YORDAMChI / MODAL FE'L + OLMOSh
    Mary IS cooking, ISN'T SHE?
    Tom CAN'T play the violin, CAN
    HE?

  PRESENT SIMPLE → do/does:
    Carol LIKES football, DOESN'T
    SHE?
  PAST SIMPLE → did:
    He FOUND his book, DIDN'T HE?

  QOIDA: TESKARISI!
  TASDIQ gap → INKOR savol:
    He works for a large computer
    firm, DOESN'T he?
  INKOR gap → TASDIQ savol:
    She didn't do her homework,
    DID she?

  ⚠ Olmosh ishlatiladi: 'Carol ...,
    doesn't SHE?' (doesn't Carol ✗).


⚠ 'A COMPUTER FIRM':

  = kompyuter firmasi.
examples: Dogs swim, don't they? / Your father is a farmer, isn't he?
Mary is cooking, isn't she? / Tom can't play the violin, can he?
Carol likes football, doesn't she? / He found his book, didn't he?
He works for a large computer firm, doesn't he?
She didn't do her homework, did she?

topics.topic: Question Tags — Ajratilgan savollar (question tags) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
MAXSUS HOLATLAR - YOD OLING!

  a) I AM → AREN'T I?
     I am quick, aren't I?
     (amn't ✗)
  b) DON'T ... → WILL YOU?
     Don't talk, will you?
  c) BUYRUQ → WILL / WON'T YOU?
     Stop shouting, will/won't you?
  d) LET'S → SHALL WE?
     Let's go out for dinner, shall
     we?
  e) HAVE (GOT) = egalik →
     HAVEN'T I?
     He has got a large house,
     hasn't he?
  f) HAVE = boshqa ma'no (yemoq,
     qilmoq) → DON'T I?
     She has dinner at 6 o'clock,
     doesn't she?
  g) THERE IS/ARE → ISN'T/AREN'T
     THERE?
     There is a cushion on the sofa,
     isn't there?
  h) THIS/THAT IS → ISN'T IT?
     That's Bob's bicycle, isn't it?


INTONATSIYA:

  ↘ PASAYADI - javobga ISHONAMIZ,
    rozilik kutamiz:
    She's your daughter, isn't
    she? ↘

  ↗ KO'TARILADI - ISHONMAYMIZ,
    tekshiramiz:
    He can't drive a car, can he? ↗


⚠ 'A CUSHION':

  = divan yostig'i.
examples: I am quick, aren't I?
Don't talk, will you?
Stop shouting, will/won't you?
Let's go out for dinner, shall we?
He has got a large house, hasn't he?
She has dinner at 6 o'clock, doesn't she?
There is a cushion on the sofa, isn't there?
That's Bob's bicycle, isn't it?

topics.topic: Exclamations — Undov gaplar (3-mashq qoidasi)
topics.rule_uz:
QOIDA:
  OT bor → WHAT (birlik sanaladigan
    → what A/AN)
  faqat SIFAT / RAVISh → HOW

  1 What A fantastic HOUSE
  2 How horrible (sifat)
  3 What A lovely DAY
  4 What AN excellent TEACHER
  5 How terrible (sifat)
  6 How thoughtful (sifat)
  7 What AN awful EXPERIENCE
  8 How clever
  9 What great MUSIC (sanalmaydi -
    a yo'q)
  10 How easy
  11 What A boring BOOK
  12 How hot
  13 What A colourful PAINTING
  14 How wonderful
  15 What A dangerous DOG

  ⚠ Unli tovush oldida AN:
  excellent, awful.


⚠ 'THOUGHTFUL':

  = e'tiborli, g'amxo'r.

topics.topic: Grammar: Reported Instructions — Grammatika: Ko'chirma buyruq/ko'rsatmalar
topics.rule_uz:
KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQLAR.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOLIP                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ask/tell + KIM + (not) + TO +
  FE'L

  'Check the manual.' →
  'He asked me TO CHECK the
   manual.'
  "Don't touch the wire." →
  'He told me NOT TO TOUCH the
   wire.'

  ⚠ INKOR: 'NOT TO' - 'to not'
  EMAS!
  ⚠ 'please' tushiriladi.
  ⚠ ask = iltimos (muloyim);
  tell = buyruq (qat'iy).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SAVOLDAN FARQI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'ChIRMA SAVOL:
    ask + wh-/if + EGA + FE'L
    (zamon orqaga)
    'She asked me where I LIVED.'

  KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ:
    ask/tell + KIM + TO + FE'L
    (infinitiv - zamon YO'Q!)
    'She told me TO GO home.'

  ⚠ Buyruqda zamon o'zgarmaydi -
  infinitiv ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'A MANUAL':

  = qo'llanma.


⚠ 'A WIRE':

  = sim.


⚠ 'A DIRECT OBJECT':

  = to'ldiruvchi (me, him, us).
examples: To report instructions we use: ask/tell + direct object + (not) + to-infinitive.
"Check the manual, please." → He asked me to check the manual.
"Don't touch the wire, please." → He told me not to touch the wire.
Difference: reported questions use ask + wh-/if + subject + verb (tense changes); reported instructions use ask/tell + object + (not) to-infinitive (no tense change).

topics.topic: Grammar: Exclamations — Grammatika: Undov gaplar
topics.rule_uz:
UNDOV GAPLAR.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  HOW + SIFAT!                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  How surprising! = Qanday
    hayratlanarli!
  How unlucky! = Qanday omadsiz!
  How strange! = Qanday g'alati!
  How wonderful! = Qanday ajoyib!
  How awful! = Qanday dahshatli!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHAT A(N) + (SIFAT) + OT!       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  What a surprise! = Qanday
    kutilmagan hodisa!
  What a shame/pity! = Qanday
    achinarli!
  What a beautiful dress! = Qanday
    chiroyli ko'ylak!
  What an awful day! = Qanday
    dahshatli kun!

  ⚠ 'What A' - sanaladigan birlik
  ot bilan. Sanalmaydigan/ko'plik
  bilan 'a' YO'Q: 'What awful
  weather!', 'What lovely flowers!'


⚠ 'A COMMENT':

  = izoh.


⚠ 'A REACTION':

  = munosabat.


⚠ 'APPEARANCE':

  = tashqi ko'rinish.


⚠ 'UPSET':

  = xafa.
examples: How + adjective! - How surprising! How unlucky! How strange! How wonderful! How awful!

topics.topic: Expressing Certainty; Will — Aniqlik bildirish; Will
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI.

  'We use MUST + infinitive WITHOUT TO
   to say that something is logically
   true.'
     'This MUST BE her bag. Her purse is
      inside it.'
     (= I'm sure the bag is hers.)

  'We use CAN'T + infinitive WITHOUT TO
   to say that something is logically
   untrue.'
     'The Rover CAN'T BE his. He's got a
      Lancia.'
     (= I'm sure the Rover isn't his.)


⚠ ENG MUHIM: 'MUST' NING IKKI MA'NOSI

  1) MAJBURIYaT:
     'You must eat only sweet potatoes.'
     = yeyishing KERAK

  2) TAXMIN (aniqlik):
     'Senan must be the older man.'
     = u bo'lsa KERAK

  ⚠ Farqi KONTEKSTdan bilinadi.
  ⚠ Taxmin ma'nosida odatda 'be' fe'li
  bilan keladi: 'must BE'.


⚠ 'CAN'T' - TAXMINNING INKORI:

  ⚠ DIQQAT: taxminni inkor qilish uchun
  'MUSTN'T' EMAS, 'CAN'T' ishlatiladi!

  'It must be him.' (u bo'lsa kerak)
  "It can't be him." (u bo'lishi mumkin
     emas)

  ⚠ "mustn't" = TAQIQ: 'You mustn't
  smoke here.' (chekish MUMKIN EMAS)


⚠ IShONCh DARAJASI:

  must be  - 95% ishonch (ha)
  might be - 50% (balki)
  can't be - 95% ishonch (yo'q)

  ⚠ 'might' 10-unitda o'rganiladi.


⚠ 'INFINITIVE WITHOUT TO':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv.
  ⚠ HAMMA modal fe'ldan keyin shunday:
     must be, can't be, will be,
     should go, might come
  ⚠ 'must to be' - XATO.


=== 'WILL' QUTISI ===

  'We use WILL + infinitive without to
   to make predictions based on what we
   believe or think. We usually use
   WILL with I think, I expect,
   probably etc.'
     'I think it WILL rain today.'

  ⚠ 'will' - TAXMINIY kelajak
  (dalilsiz, fikrga asoslangan).

  ⚠ 'be going to' esa DALILGA
  asoslangan: 'Look at those clouds -
  it's going to rain.'

  ⚠ Bu farq 5-unitda batafsil
  o'rganiladi.


⚠ 'WILL' BILAN KELADIGAN SO'ZLAR:

  I think ... will ...
  I expect ... will ...
  ... will probably ...
  I'm sure ... will ...
  Perhaps ... will ...
examples: We use must + infinitive without to to say that something is logically true.
This must be her bag. Her purse is inside it. (= I'm sure the bag is hers.)
We use can't + infinitive without to to say that something is logically untrue.
The Rover can't be his. He's got a Lancia. (= I'm sure the Rover isn't his.)
We use will + infinitive without to to make predictions based on what we believe or think.
We usually use will with I think, I expect, probably etc. I think it will rain today.

topics.topic: Grammar: Conditionals Type 0 / Time Words — Grammatika: 0-tur shart gaplari / Vaqt so'zlari (1)
topics.rule_uz:
0-TUR ShART GAPLARI
(CONDITIONALS TYPE 0).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF/WHEN + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  PRESENT SIMPLE

  'If you HEAT water, it BOILS.'
  'When sharks SMELL meat, they GET
   excited.'

  ⚠ IKKALA bo'lakda ham PRESENT
  SIMPLE - 'will' YO'Q!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAR DOIM bo'ladigan NATIJA:
  tabiat qonunlari, odatlar,
  umumiy haqiqatlar.

  ⚠ 'if' = 'when' - bu turda
  ikkalasi bir xil ma'noda!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  0-TUR va 1-TUR FARQI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  0-TUR: If you heat water, it
     BOILS. (har doim, qonun)
  1-TUR: If you heat the water,
     I'LL MAKE tea. (bir marta,
     kelajakda)

  ⚠ 1-tur 38-betda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'TO HEAT':

  = isitmoq.
  ⚠ 'heat' (ot) = issiqlik.


⚠ 'TO BOIL':

  = qaynamoq / qaynatmoq.
  ⚠ 42-betdagi 9a mashqida.


⚠ 'TO GET EXCITED':

  = hayajonlanmoq.
  ⚠ 'get' + sifat = holat
  o'zgarishi.
examples: We can use conditionals Type 0 to talk about something which always happens as a result of something else.
If you heat water, it boils.
We can use when instead of if in conditionals Type 0.
If/When sharks smell meat, they get excited.

topics.topic: Grammar: Conditionals Type 0 / Time Words — Grammatika: 0-tur shart gaplari / Vaqt so'zlari (2)
topics.rule_uz:
VAQT SO'ZLARIDAN KEYIN 'WILL' YO'Q.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOIDA                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  before, after, while, until, if,
  when + PRESENT SIMPLE
  (kelajak haqida bo'lsa ham!)

  ✓ "Let's go before it STARTS
     raining."
  ✗ "Let's go before it WILL START
     raining."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ISTISNO - SAVOL SO'ZI 'WHEN'    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'when' SAVOL so'zi bo'lsa (qachon?)
  → 'will' MUMKIN:

  "I don't know WHEN Paul WILL
   COME." (qachon kelishini
   bilmayman - SAVOL)

  'Please tell me WHEN Paul COMES.'
  (Pol kelganda menga ayting -
   VAQT)

  ⚠ FARQNI QANDAY BILISh:
  'when' ni 'qachon' deb tarjima
  qilsa bo'lsa → savol so'zi → will
  'when' ni '...ganda' deb tarjima
  qilsa bo'lsa → vaqt so'zi →
  present simple


⚠ 'WHILE':

  = ... paytida, ... ekan.
  ⚠ 'while' + PRESENT SIMPLE /
  CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 'UNTIL':

  = ... gacha.
  ⚠ 'till' - so'zlashuv shakli.
  ⚠ "I won't do anything UNTIL
  everything IS ready."
examples: We do not use will after the time words before, after, while, until, if and when; we use the present simple instead.
Let's go before it starts raining. (NOT: ... before it will start ...)
However when can be used with will if it is a question word.
I don't know when Paul will come. (question word) / Please tell me when Paul comes. (time word)

topics.topic: Grammar: too / enough; Pronouns — Grammatika: too / enough; Olmoshlar
topics.rule_uz:
TOO va ENOUGH.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TOO = JUDA (ortiqcha, SALBIY)   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIFATDAN OLDIN:
  'too close', 'too cold', 'too
   heavy'

  "Don't get TOO CLOSE to the
   python."
  ⚠ Ma'no: kerakligidan ORTIQ →
  muammo.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENOUGH = YETARLI (IJOBIY)       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIFATDAN KEYIN:
  'strong enough', 'old enough',
  'tall enough'

  'Pythons are STRONG ENOUGH to kill
   you.'
  ⚠ Ma'no: kerakli darajada.


⚠ ENG MUHIM - O'RNI:

  TOO + sifat    (too cold)
  sifat + ENOUGH (cold enough)

  ⚠ 'enough cold' - XATO!
  ⚠ Lekin OTDAN OLDIN: 'enough
  money', 'enough time'.


⚠ 'TOO ... TO' va 'ENOUGH ... TO':

  "It's TOO cold TO play." = juda
     sovuq, o'ynab bo'lmaydi
  "It's warm ENOUGH TO play." =
     o'ynash uchun yetarli iliq


⚠ 'FOR ME':

  'too heavy FOR ME to carry' = men
  ko'tarish uchun juda og'ir.


⚠ 'TOO' va 'VERY':

  very = juda (neytral)
  too = juda (ortiqcha, salbiy)
  'It's VERY hot.' - shunchaki issiq
  'It's TOO hot.' - chidab bo'lmaydi
examples: We use too before adjectives or adverbs. It has a negative meaning. Don't get too close to the python.
We use enough after adjectives or adverbs. It has a positive meaning. Pythons are strong enough to kill you.

  'There is SOMEONE in the garden.'
  something, someone, somewhere

  'Would you like SOMETHING?'

║  ANY - INKOR va SAVOLDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'Is there ANYTHING in the

╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = 'There ISN'T ANYONE in the

HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1  'at the moment' → CONTINUOUS
  2  'tomorrow' - ANIQ reja →

  3  do'kon DOIMIY sotadi → SIMPLE

  7  narx DOIMIY → SIMPLE

⚠ 4-BAND - HOLAT FE'LI:

4-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI.

  ⚠ Bu mashqning davomi keyingi betda
  (33-bet).


⚠ QOIDA (29-betdan):

  PAST SIMPLE:
     tugagan, qisqa ish
  PAST CONTINUOUS:
     uzun ish, fon, uni bo'lgan ish


HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1  'It was cold ... SO we lit a fire' -
     natija, qisqa ish → SIMPLE
  2  'I MET Ann WHILE I was doing the
     shopping' - uzun ish 'while' bilan
     → CONTINUOUS
  3  'The sun WAS SHINING WHEN John woke
     up' - fon → CONTINUOUS
  4  'He WAS READING a book WHEN the

  'She BROKE the computer when she
   TRIED to move it.'

  SIMPLE, chunki ikkalasi ham QISQA
  va KETMA-KET.

3-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI
(22-betdagi qoida).


⚠ HAR DIALOGDA 'B' AKSINI AYTADI:

  1  A: John is TALLER than Jim.
     B: No, he isn't. He's SHORTER.
     ⚠ 'tall' ning aksi 'short'.

  2  A: This was the CHEAPEST T-shirt.
     B: No, it wasn't. It was THE MOST

     ENG YUQORI daraja saqlanadi.

     B: You must be joking. It's THE

topics.topic: Grammar — Grammatika (6-mashq qoidasi) (7)
topics.rule_uz:
MAJHUL NISBAT (9-unit):
  BE + PAST PARTICIPLE (+ by ...)


JAVOBLAR:

  1 Safety gates MUST BE FITTED at
    the top and bottom of these
    stairs.
    (must + be + V3)
  2 Sputnik 1 WAS LAUNCHED by the
    Russians in 1957.
    (past simple: was + V3)
  3 Excellent service IS OFFERED by
    the hotel.
    (present simple: is + V3)
  4 The museum HAS BEEN VISITED by
    many people so far.
    (present perfect: has been + V3)
  5 The Birds WAS DIRECTED by
    Hitchcock.
    (past simple)
  6 The museum WILL BE OPENED by
    the Mayor this Friday.
    (future: will be + V3)
